NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is a happy, confident boy with a playful heart and a relaxed outlook on life. He’s the kind of dog who’s just as content having a romp around the yard as he is chilling out by your side, soaking up cuddles and pats (his favourite!). Jimmy walks with enthusiasm and might be a bit strong on the lead at times, but with a bit of practice, he’ll settle into a great walking buddy. He could potentially get along with smaller dogs too, given slow and careful introductions—he’s a sociable guy who just likes to take his time getting to know new friends. If you're after a cheerful, affectionate companion with a lovely balance of energy and calm, Jimmy could be the perfect fit!

NAME: Cooper
TEXT: Cooper is a confident, cheeky boy with a playful spark and a big personality! He’s always up for fun, whether it’s a run around the yard, a good game with a doggy mate, or heading out on an adventure. He’d thrive in an active home, especially one with another dog around his size to keep him company and match his energy. Cooper’s zest for life is infectious — he’s the kind of dog who’ll keep you laughing and moving, then happily crash for a nap once the fun’s over. If you’re looking for a playful, social, and slightly cheeky companion, Cooper could be your perfect adventure buddy!

NAME: Reggie
TEXT: Reggie is a relaxed and independent boy who’s all about the quiet life. He enjoys a bit of company and is happy to hang out with you, but he’s equally content doing his own thing — the perfect companion for someone who appreciates a low-key, easy-going dog. He does pull a little on the lead (there’s just so much to sniff!), so he’ll need a bit of guidance when it comes to walks. But with a patient and gentle hand, Reggie will soon settle into a lovely routine. If you’re looking for a calm, undemanding friend to share peaceful days with, Reggie might be your perfect match.

NAME: Jj
TEXT: JJ is a sweet, happy-go-lucky boy with the playful energy of a puppy and a heart full of love. Confident and full of charm, he’s always ready for fun — whether that’s a zoom around the garden or a goofy game with his canine pals. He’s still working on his lead manners (he’s just so excited to explore!), but with a bit of guidance, he’ll be strutting like a pro in no time. JJ might be cat-workable, but he’s definitely more in his element around other greyhounds or larger dogs. In fact, he’d thrive in a home with a doggy friend to play with and help show him the ropes. If you’re looking for a cheerful, fun-loving companion with a heart of gold, JJ is your guy!

NAME: Usyk
TEXT: Meet Usyk, a loving male dog who is seeking a simple and fulfilling life with a new family. He's a charismatic chap who adores medium-size canine companions and is always eager to make new friends. His kind-hearted nature and great spirit make him a treat to be around. Usyk is ready to embark on an enriching journey with a family that cherishes mutual growth and learning. He truly embodies the spirit of companionship and will surely become an integral part of your family. His intelligent eyes tell a story of love and loyalty that will reassure you in times of solitude and fill you with joy when times are good. Adventurous yet gentle, Usyk is the perfect companion for a family who enjoys a balance of outdoor activities and cozy time indoors. He's not a demanding pet; a simple life filled with love and care is all he aspires to. His only request? A nice, comfortable spot beside you. With a loving heart that is ready to expand and a spirit that is eager to learn, Usyk is the perfect companion for a family looking forward to welcoming a new member. He's surely the sweetheart you've been looking for. Begin a beautiful journey filled with comfort, companionship, and adventure with this wonderful dog. Usyk is excited to meet his new family and is ready to shower them with his unconditional love.

NAME: Angel
TEXT: Angel is a confident, people-loving girl who can’t resist a good cuddle session — she’s basically a professional snuggle expert. When she’s excited, she does a happy little prance that’s guaranteed to brighten your day. She walks beautifully on lead and is always ready to be your loyal companion, whether you’re a busy family or flying solo. Now, here’s the deal: Angel isn’t a fan of small dogs or cats. Think of her as the diva of the dog world who politely requests no tiny four-legged frenemies crashing her party. So, if you don’t have any pint-sized pooches or sneaky cats, Angel is all in for a lifetime of love and fun!

NAME: Jj
TEXT: JJ is a sweet and gentle boy with a heart full of love and just the right amount of playful mischief. He’s a bit of a slow burner—once he warms up, you’ll discover his fun-loving, zoomie-ready side that’s always up for a quick burst of excitement. JJ walks nicely on lead and enjoys a good balance between lively adventures and laid-back chill time. While he’s not a big fan of cats, his charming personality more than makes up for it! If you’re after a gentle companion with a dash of goofy energy and plenty of love to give, JJ is the perfect match.

NAME: Thor
TEXT: Thor is one handsome, sweet-natured boy who knows how to keep things cool. This relaxed gentleman is as happy to kick back and chill as he is to join you on an adventure—he’s got the perfect balance of laid-back charm and eager enthusiasm. Thor walks like a dream on lead and absolutely adores pats and cuddles (honestly, who wouldn’t?). He’s fantastic with kids, super low maintenance, and ready to be your loyal sidekick through all of life’s ups and downs. If you want a handsome, easy-going companion who’s all about good vibes and great company, Thor’s your guy!

NAME: Mel
TEXT: Mel is a friendly and joyful girl with a playful spirit and a heart full of love. She’s naturally cuddly and thrives on affection, making her the perfect companion for anyone seeking warmth and fun. When she’s out exploring, Mel gets quite excited and enthusiastic, so she may benefit from a little lead training to help her walk calmly and confidently. Whether you’re a family with kids or someone looking for a devoted solo companion, Mel’s sweet and charming personality will quickly win you over. She’s eager to share her love and devotion, and with a bit of guidance, she’ll flourish into the perfect adventure buddy and snuggle partner.

NAME: Carter
TEXT: Carter is gentle, walks on a loose leash, and would be the kind of greyhound who could live with respectful kids, or older/elderly folks, due to his laid back nature. He is lovely around dogs big or small here at the centre and would be happy to live with them. Carter would enjoy a small backyard/townhouse to call his own. He can have bursts of quirky excitement like other greyhounds but overall he is a relaxed greyhound. He is great with people in general, loves pats and will snuggle into you (to sneak in a face lick). He loves treats and attention and would do well with a family who are looking for a placid greyhound to add to the family. He is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Spud
TEXT: Spud is a lovable brindle boy with a heart as big as his paws. This gentle giant is the epitome of calm and cuddly, making him the perfect companion for families. Despite his size, Spud is well-mannered and easy to walk on a lead, never pulling or jumping. He adores children and has been living happily in a home with kids. Spud is a true people-lover who thrives on affection and belly rubs. His favourite pastime? Snuggling up on the couch, where he can relax and enjoy the company of his humans. He's also a foodie at heart, always eager for mealtime. Social and friendly, Spud gets along wonderfully with other greyhounds, as well as both large and small dogs, even cats. His easy going nature and big teddy bear personality make him a perfect pet for any loving home, preferably with someone home some of the day, or a home or part-time worker.

NAME: Ester
TEXT: Ester may have just celebrated her 10th birthday, but this sweet, gentle lady still has so much love to give! Ester has spent some time in a unit apartment foster care home. A well-mannered, affectionate soul, she adores the company of other greyhounds and is open to meeting new friends with a proper introduction—especially other medium or large breeds. Ester’s ideal day includes lounging on a comfy pillow, taking a leisurely walk, and enjoying quiet moments with her humans. Though she’s an “older” gal, Ester still has plenty of spunk and would love a calm, loving home to call her own. She’s the perfect companion for someone looking for a loyal, relaxed dog to share their home, maybe couch, and life’s simple pleasures. Ester is ready to fill your heart with the kind of love only a senior dog can bring—gentle, kind, and full of gratitude. Could you be the one to offer Ester the forever home she deserves? If you’re ready to make her golden years the best yet, come meet this sweet lady today. She’s waiting to shower you with love! 🐾💕

NAME: Snip
TEXT: Snip, Snippy, Snipper dog....she's one of a kind. Such a pretty girl with her white nose, chest and socks and even a beautiful little mane of hair down the back of her neck (a whorl of hair that sticks up), making her a very special girl indeed. Snip is a darling; kind and affectionate, and just loves loving you. She is also playful, friendly, and loves her food - she will eat anything you put in front of her! Luckily she loves her walkies to keep her trim, playing in the yard with her toys or throwing/kicking a ball with her. Snip is a good traveller and loves going in the car, off on adventures! Snip would suit an active family with older kids 10+ or a couple with a backyard to play in and time to spend with her. Although Snip is used to the whippets and terriers, she would probably be best as an only dog or with a larger male dog or greyhound.

NAME: Barba
TEXT: Barba is a beautiful boy who loves adventure. Barba would be ideal for the young professional couple or single person looking to give a dog a structured life. Barba whilst growing up in a residential street has limited house exposure. Barba is very good to take on longer walks and is a very good learner. Barba with the correct introduction would be good with medium to large dogs

NAME: Parade
TEXT: Parade is a beautiful smaller girl who is looking for her perfect companion. Parade has grown up in a residential street and would be suited to someone with a backyard or courtyard. Parade travels well in the car and enjoys a walk around the local streets Parade has grown up around other greyhounds and loves getting pats from the neighbourhood children when she knows them. Parade is the perfect mix for someone that likes short walks and a dog that sleeps the day and night away.

NAME: Poppy
TEXT: Poppy Is a beautiful Brindle female that loves to play. Whether it be at the local oval or having a run around your backyard this girl loves to zoom. Poppy is good with older kids and is the perfect first pet for a family. Poppy settles well and walks very well on lead Poppy has grown up in a backyard where she enjoys sunning herself after a quick play. Poppy is currently undertaking some house training and is progressing very well. enquire today to find out more about Poppy

NAME: Pop Tart
TEXT: Pop Tart is a stunning lady with a heart as sweet as her name. She might be a little shy at first—think of her as a delicate flower that needs some gentle nurturing and patience to truly bloom. With the right person to give her space and time, she’ll slowly come out of her shell and reveal the delightful, goofy, and affectionate friend she’s been hiding all along. Once Pop Tart trusts you, she transforms into the ultimate cuddle buddy and loyal sidekick, ready to fill your days with warmth, laughter, and a touch of silly charm. If you’re ready to invest in a special friendship that grows beautifully at its own pace, Pop Tart can’t wait to meet you!

NAME: Alfie
TEXT: Alfie is a happy, excitable greyhound with a heart full of love and a personality that will keep you smiling. This sweet boy is a total cuddle bug who loves giving kisses and soaking up all the affection you have to offer. Whether he’s off on an adventure or just chilling at home, Alfie is your perfect companion — always ready for fun but also totally content to relax by your side. While Alfie isn’t a big fan of cats, his funny and charming personality more than makes up for it! If you’re looking for a loyal buddy who’s full of life and love, Alfie might just be the one for you.

NAME: Maggie
TEXT: Maggie is a sweet and affectionate girl who’s all about the cuddles once she feels safe and settled. While she may be a little reserved at first, with patience and gentle encouragement, she’ll soon reveal her loving and loyal nature. Maggie would thrive in a calm, family-oriented home—especially one with older kids who can respect her space as she finds her feet. She enjoys the company of people and forms strong bonds once she’s had time to build trust. She might be okay with a calm, small dog companion, but would need a slow introduction to ensure everyone gets along. If you’re looking for a loving companion and are happy to give Maggie the time and support she needs to shine, she could be the perfect fit for your family.

NAME: Neon
TEXT: 🖤 Meet Neon – The Belly Rub Queen! 🖤 Neon is a gentle 4-year-old black greyhound with a heart of gold and a love for human company. She’s the kind of dog who will quietly follow you from room to room, just happy to be near her people. Her soulful eyes and calm presence make her an instant favorite with everyone she meets. She adores belly rubs and will happily roll over to show you her soft side – literally! She’s affectionate, easygoing, and would thrive in a home where she can be part of the family and soak up all the love and attention she deserves. Whether you’re relaxing on the couch or enjoying a quiet walk, Shadow will be right by your side, making every moment a little brighter.

NAME: Jazz
TEXT: Meet Jazz – The Life of the Paw-ty 🐱 Cats – Yes! 🐶 Other Dogs – Absolutely! ⚡ Energy Level – Zoomies guaranteed! Jazz is a gorgeous 4-year-old brindle greyhound with a zest for life and a heart full of love. She’s a social girl who gets along with other dogs and is even cat workable, making her a perfect fit for a multi-pet household. Jazz thrives on activity and would love a home where she can stretch her legs, play to her heart’s content, and then snuggle up for some well-deserved downtime.

NAME: Arnie
TEXT: A true superstar, introducing Arnie! With a name like Arnie, it’s no surprise this guy is ready to bring some action into your life. He’s ready to run into your heart faster than a speeding chopper! If you’ve ever watched Arnie in Predator, you know that underneath that tough exterior is a soft spot that only the right person can unlock. Arnie is no different! With a calm and loving nature, he’ll cuddle up with you after a long day of zoomies, providing the perfect balance of strength and sweetness. Arnie would suit a backyard, a house with stair access, and doesn't mind some stints being left alone as solo pet however would suit a home with another M-L canine companion. If you're ready to bring Arnie into your life and experience a life of creating your own highlight reel...contact GAP. Arnie is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre...let the adventures begin!

NAME: Roy
TEXT: Roy is a 4-year-old greyhound who has grown up in a rural environment and is now looking for his forever home. He is a clean and well-mannered dog who never messes in his kennel, showing great potential for transitioning into a home environment with a little support for house training. He’s an excitable boy who enjoys a good run around but doesn’t jump up or show signs of destructive behaviour. Roy gets along well with other greyhounds and would thrive either as a solo dog or with a calm canine companion. Roy is well-suited to homes where the owners work full-time, as he is independent and relaxed when left alone. He would do best with a secure yard and regular opportunities to stretch his legs, ideally in a quiet, calm setting similar to his upbringing. Roy is a gentle, happy dog who just needs a little time and patience to adjust to home life. With the right guidance, he will make a loving and loyal companion.

NAME: Dixie
TEXT: Dixie is a 4-year-old brindle greyhound and the sister of Roy. She’s a smaller girl with a big personality, full of charm and playful energy. Dixie is a good kennel dog who keeps her space clean and enjoys a structured routine. She’s an excited little lady who absolutely loves to show off her zoomies in the yard. Despite her bursts of energy, she settles down quickly and is happy to relax once she’s had a chance to stretch her legs. Dixie would suit a family environment and is good with children aged 5 and up. She’s gentle, affectionate, and thrives on attention. With her easy-going nature and love of fun, Dixie would make a delightful addition to a home that can offer her both playtime and plenty of cuddles.

NAME: Buddy
TEXT: Meet Buddy! A happy, friendly dog who loves meeting people, is easy going and loves life. Basking in the sun is one of his favourites past-times, as is playing in the yard with his greymates and attention from his humans. He loves it when he comes inside and lies on the rug but would love a couch all to himself (currently occupied by the 'boss' girls). He's also happy spending time on his own during the day, hanging out in the garden, sun-snoozing on the grass or in a sheltered spot in cooler times (veranda, gazebo). Buddy is an easy maintenance lad who just wants some love and attention and a cruisy, simple life. He will making a loving companion for anyone wanting an affectionate friend to hang out with. 💙

NAME: Hope
TEXT: We hope that you’ll fall in love when you first lay eyes on our teeny tiny beautiful girl, Hope! Weighing in at just 25 kgs, Hope is a sweet, confident and gentle girl. She enjoys going for walks, walks lovely on the leash, and is beautiful around kids 5-10 years old. A home with respectable children would be suited. This happy vibrant girl is great with other medium to large dogs as well. If you can’t bear the idea of not having Hope in your life then apply to adopt her today!

NAME: Mila
TEXT: This is Mila! She may only have 3 legs, but that wont stop her from showing you endless love and affectionate once she gets to know you! She may be a little timid at first in new environments, but it wont take long for her to warm up to you, leaning in for pats and cuddles. Mila enjoys the company of dogs and cats ideally with a calm nature, just likes hers. She's learnt to navigate the world on 3 legs and could suit apartment living on the ground floor or with lift access. Do you think Mila could be the girl for you? Meet her at Western Sydney 🐾

NAME: Betsy
TEXT: Betsy would do well in a quiet and respectful household with a fenced yard to romp around in. Betsy will thrive in a home where she can learn how to be the best pet she can be! She is a friendly girl who is stepping her paws into pet life for the first time & would do best in a quiet neighbourhood. Betsy is available to adopt from our Londonderry Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Kirby
TEXT: Oh hey there! My name's Kirby and I would love to tell you all about how I would be your perfect pet! I've had some experience living as a pet and I was an excellent house guest however we discovered I really love my food. The amazing trainers here at GAP have been working on my sharing, so my new home can continue this training with their help. Fun games like "leave it" (which I'm getting really good at by the way!) are doing wonders in my progress! Running around and playing in the sun is the best thing ever, and I would love my new fur-ever home to have a backyard to call my own. With my love for sunbaking and zoomies I am more than happy being a predominantly outside dog with supervised or restricted access to the house. Full-time workers are a-ok with me, though I am still a big snuggle bug who will shower you with love and affection when you get home. I love exploring new places and my friends at GAP say I walk very well on lead, so if you're looking for a walking partner for your quiet morning/evening stroll I'm your guy. Not to brag, but I really am a true genius, mastering many cues including "down", "stay", "shake", "touch", "crate", "leave it", "heel", and—drumroll, please—the legendary greyhound sit! I find daily training sessions and enrichment activities super fun and a great way to keep my super smart brain occupied and stimulated. I can't wait to meet my forever family! So come on down to GAP Western Sydney to meet (and fall in love with) me!

NAME: Mauve
TEXT: Blue girl Mauve is a playful, fun loving and happy girl. She loves to lean into you for pats and has that perfect outgoing and affectionate personality which is infectious and unforgettable! She may only have 3 legs but we don't think anyone has actually informed her...as she gets around just fine! She loves playing, doing zoomies and has perfected the 'greyhound lean' too. She does well indoors and would suit unit/apartment life (with a lift so she doesn't need to do stairs). Shorter walks are totally fine by Mauve as long as she gets some mental enrichment and cuddles when you get home. She has done well in her initial alone time testing and would be happy to be left alone as a solo pet. This gorgeous girl has an infectious happy personality which we think many home types will adore! She is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jack (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi there! My names Jack - I'm a super friendly affectionate boy who's ready to bring lots of love and fun to your life! I'm a confident guy, happy being around all my human friends and meeting new ones on my adventures. I also show really positive interactions with other dogs of all sizes, so depending on how a meet and greet goes, I may not mind sharing my new home with a canine buddy. I travel well, so would be happy to head out on adventures with my new family! Come down and meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Cowboy
TEXT: This chilled out Cowboy is ready to find his forever home! This handsome and gentle boy would suit a home with respectful children, big or small dogs, and of course some toys to keep him company. Not only is he fabulous around children, he's been learning to go on walks with the kids, and he's well known for being quite confident across the board in many new situations. He's happy living in a house/townhouse or a unit apartment (he can also walk up and down stairs!). He would make a wonderful family pet due to his charming and adaptable nature. Cowboy is available at Western Sydney's adoption centre.

NAME: Archie
TEXT: Archie is a gentle hound who has a calm, non jumpy, laid back nature. He has spent some time in a home and the feedback is: "He has been perfect, slept through the night, no inside accidents, amazing on the lead, friendly to everyone he meets and does not seem bothered at all." Never too over the top and never boisterous, Archie is a lovely hound. If you want an affectionate and gentle boy, keep reading! Archie is excellent on the lead with no pulling. He plays nicely with other greyhounds, spending time in our office with other greyhounds to simulate a home environment. He has excelled with stairs, too. He is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Donna
TEXT: Donna or Don as she's known to her friends is a gorgeous girl who enjoys spending time around kids 3-5 years old, lapping up all the pats and love from those she trusts. A bit on the shy side at first but warms up, we've noticed she loves attention, her playful side comes out when she is relaxed. She loves kids and playing with soft toys, balls, water. She will be a great pet with an owner/family who has patience at start to allow time/space to settle & trust. She's well across getting lots of love and pats from her humans and would love a family who will give her cuddles and attention. She has done brilliantly in her initial testings with small animals including cats and small dogs and with gradual introductions will thrive in a multi-pet home. This gorgeous girl can be summed up as placid and playful. If you're looking for the perfect match for your pets, kids, and easy going lifestyle, we think Donna could be the one!

NAME: Elsie
TEXT: Little Elsie is a very friendly & affectionate girl, she has a nice calm but confident nature. This happy girl loves toys and is confident all round making her a wonderful addition to a home with or without children, she has learnt to play nice with children regularly. She loves popping in to see the neighbours and is a perfect little social butterfly! Elsie is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ashton
TEXT: Ashton has been around children of all ages from 1 to 16 making him a great addition to a young, growing family. He's spent some time around working dogs including border collies and kelpies and understands their social dynamic, so would suit a home with any medium to large dogs with a bit of drive. He is a beautiful hound who would fit seamlessly into so many home types - enquire about Ashton with the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Jack is a confident hound looking for his forever home. Jack still has some beans and would enjoy a backyard to romp around. He would enjoy an outdoor and indoor life where he can join you where ever you are. He has a vibrant and joyful personality which children would enjoy! Jack is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Anna
TEXT: Anna loves kids, and is a quiet, gentle and friendly girl ready to show off her beautiful social skills in her forever home. She walks gently on lead and can initially be a little bit shy but warms up with treats and toys. This gorgeous girl would suit a home with another hound and a quiet home where she can thrive into the confident girl we know she can be! This gentle and affectionate girl will show you she likes you by sniffing your face! Find out the gentle love of a greyhound with Anna, Anna is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Harry
TEXT: Harry is a total catch! He is friendly, confident, good with humans and dogs, and a happy bubbly boy. He likes to play, has a good food drive, showing to be very trainable, he also walks lovely on the leash. He is confident on lead and in new environments as well as super polite with our greyhounds and small dogs here at the centre. Harry is a gentle, yet playful, lovely mix of all the perfect greyhound quirks! If he's not smooching up to you, he's sniffing out the treats in your pocket or finding a toy to entertain himself with. This goofy love bug is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Henry
TEXT: Henry has lived his life surrounded by children, and would suit a home with a family of children who are eager to give him lots of love. Henry is a social butterfly who loves a bit of attention! He would suit a home with another medium to large dog who is on the chill side like him. His previous owners have summed him up as a big goof ball, who is placid, even a little bit clumsy! He settles well on his bed and is happy to watch the world go by with you by his side. Henry is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Meri
TEXT: Little 23kg Meri has been around children 1+ to 14 years old, she loves a bit of attention and loves to run off with toys and have a bit of fun. She is a friendly, confident, yet relaxed girl. Meri would enjoy a backyard/townhouse with or without a greyhound pal to spend her days with, she would also be suitable around children due to her history of exposure with kids! Meri is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bo
TEXT: Bo has beautiful moo-cow markings, making him stand out here at the centre. He also stands out of the crowd due to his confident, happy-go-lucky nature. He has an sometimes energetic side and loves his training sessions, showing off his amazing engagement and ability to learn new tricks. He is confident around new people and loves neck scratches from anyone who'll give them. He enjoys spending time around bigger dogs and would suit a backyard/townhouse as he loves having a bit of a run to burn off those greyhound zoomies. A home with respectful children will be a great fit, too. Bo is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Maverick
TEXT: This handsome, sweet, gentle, calm and loving boy is Maverick. He is calm natured, sweet and quiet. He enjoys a little bit of attention but is a relaxed boy happy to do his own thing. He loves spending time indoors in our office. He loves a quiet, gentle lifestyle and has an amazing personality which would suit respectful children. He is also a highly polite boy with our greyhounds onsite and would suit a home with another hound. He is cautious on staircases at the moment so if he lives in a unit/apartment, a lift would be best at this stage. He has spent long stints alone in our office space and does well independently, meaning he could suit longer hours left alone. He enjoys being indoors so doesn't need a large yard to be happy. This stunning boy is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Popeye
TEXT: Popeye is a handsome, goofy boy who's bursting with personality. He lives for playtime, whether it's a good game of fetch, tug with his favourite rope toy, or zoomies in the yard. He's social and enjoys the company of other medium to large dogs, especially those who can keep up with his playful energy. Popeye would thrive in an active household or with someone who has a secure backyard where he can stretch those long legs and get his daily dose of fun. He's also happy just hanging out once he's had his play, he knows how to chill when the time is right. When it comes to walks, Popeye has been doing really well with his training. He's learning to stay focused and calm, especially when small dogs are around. He does best when you bring his favourite toy along, it helps redirect his attention and keeps him happily engaged with you. Ongoing positive training and consistent management have helped him progress beautifully. With the right guidance, Popeye's a total gem. He's smart, responsive, and full of love to give. In return, you'll gain a loyal sidekick who's always ready for fun and fiercely devoted to his people.

NAME: Ronaldo
TEXT: This laid back character is currently living amongst the trees around all sorts of creatures like native birds, the occasional wallabies to a friendly border collie he plays with and different smaller breeds of dogs that come past. He has free range chicken walking around and also enjoys being walked around the property by the young kids. He is very friendly and playful, he also adores affection.

NAME: Emma
TEXT: Emma is a gorgeous girl, she likes to play, loves to cuddle and loves to relax. Emma has been exposed to various creatures domestic and native from goats and chickens to poodles, fox terriers and native birds. She has always lived around a family and is great with kids and good to be left on her own while your at work.

NAME: Nate
TEXT: Meet Nate, the gentle soul. He's a sweet and loving male greyhound who has stolen the hearts of everyone he meets. With a gentle demeanour and a knack for snuggling, Nate is the perfect companion for those cosy, cold days. He'll happily curl up beside you, providing warmth and affection whenever you need it. Nate is fully housetrained, making him an easy-going addition to any home. He loves walks, enjoying the sights and smells around him, but he's also equally happy at home as your one and only companion, where he can shower you with love and cuddles and play in the back yard, throwing a tennis or soccer ball to him. If you’re looking for a loyal friend who thrives on companionship and affection, Nate is your boy!

NAME: Ox
TEXT: Ox is the big softie that makes your heart melt. Ox is currently living inside a home learning to love the relaxed life. Ox still enjoys his walk and is a delight to walk on lead. This big guy is a kind hearted boy who loves sleeping the day away. Ox enjoys human company but is also happy to be left alone for full time working hours. Ox enjoys a car ride and lazing on his bed in your home

NAME: Willow
TEXT: Willow is a sweet and gentle soul with a heart full of love to give. This petite brindle girl has grown up around children as young as five and thrives in a family environment. Willow has spent time inside the home and is crate trained, making her well-adjusted to a household routine. She’s small-dog workable and has shown she can live comfortably alongside other canine companions with appropriate introductions. Willow would suit a full-time worker as she’s content to snooze the day away, especially when given a comfy bed and a few toys. Willow doesn’t ask for much—just a short daily walk and a secure courtyard to stretch her legs. With time, patience, and continued training, she could adapt well to apartment living too. If you’re after a low-maintenance, affectionate companion to fit your lifestyle, Willow might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Raven
TEXT: Raven is a bright, affectionate little brindle girl who brings a calm presence to any home. Raised with young children, she’s gentle and respectful—making her a lovely option for families or first-time dog owners. This sweet girl is crate trained and has spent time indoors, so she understands the rhythm of household life. Raven is small-dog workable and would be happy living with another dog, given the right introductions. She’s also perfectly suited to full-time workers, as she’s more than happy to relax during the day and save her energy for a short evening walk. Raven would thrive in a townhouse with a courtyard and—with a little guidance and consistency—could easily adapt to apartment life. Looking for a loyal companion who’s calm, adaptable, and low-fuss? Raven could be the one for you.

NAME: Max
TEXT: if you are looking for a boy who is very laid back and affectionate at the same time then you must meet Max Max is a beautiful and soft black boy who is looking for his perfect backyard Max enjoys a daily walk and has grown up around small children. Max enjoys lazing the day away in the sun and is a very care free boy. Max was raised around small sausage dogs and has lived with other greyhounds. Max is the final piece to a families perfect puzzle

NAME: Carly
TEXT: Carly may take a little time to fully warm up but once she does, you'll find a wonderfully affectionate pup. Patience will reveal Carly's true nature: a loyal and cuddly grey. Carly can be apprehensive and may shy away when approached from above, but if you crouch down to her level, you'll soon discover her gentle heart and spark of curiosity. Her ideal home would be a calm environment where she can enjoy plenty of affection and cozy snuggles without feeling rushed or overwhelmed. A home with a part-time worker would be an excellent fit for Carly, as she'd benefit from having company during the day. With time, patience, and love, Carly will become an irreplaceable member of your household, full of love and ready to receive it in return.

NAME: Lola
TEXT: Lola is a stunning young hound, she is very interactive, she loves playing with toys and will keep coming back for a pat and a cuddle. She has seen a variety of livestock and native animals living in a semi rural setting. She spends time around a toddler who she is very careful and affectionate with. She would fit in well to a lot of peoples lives.

NAME: Alf
TEXT: Alf is a handsome young male. He is destined for pet life as he is a relaxed, playful, affectionate confident boy. He loves getting in the water when he can, he enjoys lounging around the yard, he is good with young children and is from a semi rural property.

NAME: Diamond
TEXT: Meet Diamond, a gentle soul in search of a cozy and loving new family. Suitable for a home that embraces peace and calm, Diamond will find joy in an environment with older children who can understand and respect her initial need for space. While she may appear a little wary upon first meeting, Diamond quickly blossoms into an affectionate companion who will melt your heart. Her loyalty and sweet nature come to light once she feels safe and secure, revealing her soft and loving side. Diamond walks beautifully on the lead, making her a delightful partner for leisurely strolls around the neighborhood. She's had some experience with dachshunds and chickens, suggesting a potential for adaptability with the right introductions.

NAME: Chalbino
TEXT: Meet Chalbino, destined to make his new family's hearts overflow with happiness. This cheeky yet confident boy, radiatesenthusiasm through his whole body, especially his wagging tail that seems to have a mind of its own! Chalbino is eager to join a lively household that matches his love for play. At times he is strong on the lead due to sheer excitement rather than power, making each walk an adventure. A happy heart in a furry package, Chalbino is always ready to engage and fill your day with laughter and companionship. His impeccable house training, developed after overcoming a neck injury as a pup, demonstrates his resilience and adaptability.

NAME: Lucy (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi there! I'm Lucy🐾 I'm a sweet, gentle girl looking for a new place to call home! I've been living as a pet with my cattle dog buddy for a while now, so I wouldn't mind meeting another canine friend to potentially go home with. Oh and I'm not just a pretty face, I'm very smart too! I know how to do down, shake and I come when my name is called. I'm confident, friendly and looking forward to being a apart of your family 🏠 Come down and meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Diesel (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi, I'm Diesel 🐾 I'm a gorgeous confident boy, ready to bring some fun to the life of my new family. I adore all humans and even grew up around children myself, making me the perfect addition to your family! I would love my new home all to myself as I thrive when I'm the only star of the show⭐ Oh and I also love to play and chase after my toys so a backyard would be great for me! If you think I could be the guy for you, come and meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Missy (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Missy! This lovely lady is looking for her new family and cant wait to meet you at Western Sydney. Missy can be a little shy at first but in time she will show you just how sweet she is, leaning in for pats any chance she gets. Missy has three legs, but that doesn't stop her! She's learning to navigate the world and is doing wonderfully, taking it all in her stride. She gets along well with other dogs and wouldn't mind going home with a canine buddy, pending a meet and greet. If you're looking for a friendly, affectionate additional to your family, Missy is your girl 🐾

NAME: Kane
TEXT: Kane is a social and confident lad with a charming personality. Kane is a good traveller, enjoys spending time with other hounds and has been described as playful, fun, and very lazy! He is a wonderful blend of calm, with that perky playful side! Kane would enjoy a townhouse/backyard, and a home with or without respectful children. A family with another M-L canine companion would also be well suited to this sweet gentleman. Kane is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Cuddles
TEXT: Hi, I'm Cuddles! Not only do I know how to cuddle, I also know how to "sit" which is apparently a big deal for greyhounds - who knew?! I've been socialised around a few types of dogs, so I'm ready to join a multi-dog household or one who would like their dog to head down to the cafe and catch up with the local dogs. I have been around a mini foxy X chihuahua and a kelpie, and of course greyhounds too, whom I love. I haven't met those little humans called children before but I am a sweet girl who is pretty happy and confident, so I'm sure I'd take it all in my stride. Lastly, I have also met cats, so they say I have passed my testing and am ready to go home! Enquire with the Western Sydney team to meet me.

NAME: Reba
TEXT: Reba is our 7-year-old girl with a soft heart and an even softer spot for cuddles. She’s incredibly affectionate, calm, and friendly. The kind of dog who wants nothing more than to be by your side, whether that’s curling up on the couch or quietly following you through the house. Her gentle nature makes her a great fit for families, including those with children. Reba is also wonderfully independent. She’s perfectly suited to full-time workers, as she’s happy to relax during the day and will greet you with the warmest welcome when you return. She gets along well with other medium to large dogs and could happily share her home with a canine companion of similar size. Reba would love a home with a secure backyard where she can enjoy her own little adventures, zoomies, sunbathing, and taking in the breeze. She doesn’t need daily walks, and in fact, would be happiest in a home where walks are optional. She’s a great pet for a low-key lifestyle with plenty of love, a routine, and the freedom to just be herself. Reba is ready to be someone’s heart dog, a loyal, loving companion who asks for very little but gives so much in return.

NAME: Meraki
TEXT: Hi, I'm Meraki 🐾 I'm a super sweet girl, who cant wait to find my new home! I can be a little shy at first, but with a bit of time and a chance to warm up to you, I'll be ready to give and take lots of love 💖 I wouldn't mind sharing my new home with another canine buddy, big or small! In fact, I think a new friend is exactly what I'll need in my new home, depending on how our meet and greet goes of course. I can't wait to meet you at Western Sydney!

NAME: Lulu
TEXT: This is Lulu 🐾 This confident girl is full of life and is ready to bring lots of love and fun into your home! Lulu shows lots of training potential as a few treats are the way to this girls heart. Lulu loves to give affection just as much as she loves to give it and cant wait to find her new family. Her new family might even already have a another dog, which Lulu wouldn't mind! Are you ready for lovely Lulu to become apart of your family? Meet her at Western Sydney 😄

NAME: Siri
TEXT: Say Hey Siri, to Siri 👋 This gorgeous girl knows it all and is ready to teach you a thing or two about bringing fun to your life! Any questions you have, Siri has the answer for! What to do on a beautiful sunny day? Throw her toys around in the backyard of course! What about when the weather isn't so great? Movies in bed ALL day she reckons! Do greyhounds get along with other dogs? She sure does! How do I win my new greyhound over? Treats, treats and more treats is always her answer! Is Siri everything you've been looking for? Her answer is YES! Come down and meet her at Western Sydney 🐾

NAME: Evie
TEXT: Hi, I'm Evie! I'm a sweet, gentle girl looking for a place to call home! I love my walks and have shown to be quite well mannered whilst I'm out and about. I may be a little shy at first but once I warm up to you, I love lots of pats and ear scratches. I love my greyhound buddies, and pending a meet and greet, I wouldn't mind going home with canine companion! I cant wait to meet my new family 🏠 If you think I might be the girl for you, come meet me at Western Sydney 🐾

NAME: Lilly
TEXT: Lilly is a gorgeous girl who gets along with everyone, she is great with kids, shares space with other dogs and has lived around native wildlife on the south coast. She is affectionate and social.

NAME: Sandy (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *Sandy is in a foster home with 2 greyhounds - check in for more updates soon!* Weighing in at just 24 kg this teeny tiny girl makes up for her size with her adorable personality! Sweet, happy, confident little girl Sandy requires a home with human, or preferably canine companionship. She is a social butterfly who thrives around other dogs so we would love to see her forever home be much like her foster home, where she has dog companionship. She is a confident lady who walks super nicely on the lead. She likes treats and will definitely persuade you with her puppy dog eyes. She has spent time living with other greyhounds in foster and before her GAP days, and would be a fabulous fit for a multi-dog household. Playful and loving, she absolutely loves people and has never met someone she didn't like - making her suitable for a busy social life or a family with active kids. She is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Juliet
TEXT: Meet sweet girl Juliet. A big cuddler at heart, she loves to curl up next to you on the couch. Juliet loves playing around in the water and enjoys a good game of fetch. Juliet has had exposure to household environments as well as children aged 2-16years old.

NAME: Emi
TEXT: Emi is a very sweet little lady who shines once she feels comfortable. She loves jumping up for snuggles and cuddles, and enjoys chasing toys during playtime. Emi has grown up around children and would do well with the company of medium to large dogs. Gentle, playful, and full of heart, she’s ready to find a loving home to call her own.

NAME: Prince
TEXT: Prince is a very handsome boy with a playful heart and a love for life! He’s affectionate, engaging, and always up for a game of chase with his favorite toys. Prince gets along well with smaller dogs and would be thrilled to have a yard where he can run and play to his heart’s content.

NAME: Dolly
TEXT: Dolly is a charming girl, she likes meeting new people. She is very cuddly and affectionate. She comes when called and plays with toys. She is a good mixture of a hound that wants to go for a walk and be social with also wanting to lounge around doing nothing.

NAME: Ned
TEXT: This boy is made to fit into a family. He is super affectionate, plays with toys, enjoys laying around the yard and is good to be left alone.

NAME: Katie
TEXT: Katie is a lovely hound, she is very friendly with everyone, she is great with pups and young kids also. She is pretty lazy and would suit a lifestyle where she would appreciate a small daily walk followed by relaxing and going at her own pace. She is social and confident and is comfortable being left alone.

NAME: Matey
TEXT: Ahoy Matey! Matey is the finest gem of them all! With his pretty blue coat, floppy ears and happy go lucky energy, this Matey is a bounty of charm waiting to be adopted! Matey has spent some time in a foster care home and we have learnt he loves spending time with his family and going for a quiet sniffari around the block! He is a super outgoing boy who just loves everyone he meets, especially if you have some yummy treats or play a game of fetch with him! Matey is an enthusiastic and fun-loving boy making him suitable for those wanting a playful companion and would do best in a home without young kids or other pets. Matey suits part-time or full-time workers provided he lives in a quiet area with opaque fencing so he can just relax and snooze the day away in the backyard. Get ready to meet your new best Matey! This handsome boy is available now from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Oakley
TEXT: Oakley is an energetic and fun loving greyhound, he thrives when given structured activities. His ideal owner will love all of his drive, energy and passion for all things fun. His best fit would be an owner who is eager to actively train and work with him. He is a driven hound driven who loves physical and mental stimulation. His perfect match will be someone looking for a highly trainable and driven dog who enjoys training as much as he does. He has a strong need for physical and mental stimulation. His recall is excellent, he performs 'down' on cue, and he has the ability to walk nicely in heel position after exercise. He loves the outdoors and would do best as an outside dog. He is available now from our Western Sydney centre.

NAME: Flint
TEXT: **Flint has done his 6 weeks of foster care and excelled! He's back at the centre now and ready for adoption - reach out to the team to find out more!** Flint is a polite gentleman when it comes to people & other dogs. He would suit a calm canine friend in his forever home. He’s all about manners and will leave you impressed with how well he interacts with both humans and other greyhounds. Flint is quick to learn and takes training in stride, making him a highly trainable and adaptable companion. He is currently in a foster care home where he is picking up all the pet skills to be the best pet he can be for when he finds his forever home. Flint is a polite young man who can't wait to meet you. He's available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Sully
TEXT: Hi, I'm Sully, a gentle, quiet natured blue boy looking for my new home. I get along great with other dogs and don’t mind spending time in the yard while you’re out – but I do love having the freedom to go in and out as I please. I’m happiest in a home with a yard where I can stretch my legs and take in the fresh air throughout the day. I love the water – so much so that I even took a dip in the river (see photos)! I also travel great in the car and enjoy my walks, especially in quiet areas while I continue building my confidence. When I first started going on walks, I wasn’t sure what to do, but with some patience and encouragement, I’ve learned to keep going and haven’t had any issues in a long time! Now, I just take my time getting used to new environments, and once I do, I’m all in. I have even learnt to walk up and down stairs! I also have experience in a pet home, so I already know the routine of a home life. I’m comfortable being left alone for a few hours, especially with a yard to explore and settle in, but I thrive best in a home where I still get plenty of interaction throughout the day. I love being around my people and enjoy a good balance of companionship and independence. And when the day winds down, you’ll find me cozied up in my crate – it’s my little safe haven where I sleep soundly through the night. I'm available at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Lemon
TEXT: Whether it's her adorable overbite smile, or cheeky playful nature, Lemon is a sweet and gentle soul with a heart full of love to give. She is super affectionate and adorable and suits indoor unit/apartment living or a backyard. Read on to see what she's learnt during her time at GAP, proving you can teach an older dog new tricks! Lemon has conquered the following exciting milestones: - Walking up and down stairs - Hanging out with other greyhounds - Learning to toilet on cue - The 'touch' cue Lemon would suit a home with respectful children and a house with a backyard or unit/apartment, and would enjoy living with another likeminded greyhound too! Lemon doesn’t ask for much—just a short daily walk and some love and TLC. If Lemon sounds like she will bring the zest into your life, come and meet her at our Western Sydney Facility!

NAME: Peanut
TEXT: Peanut is a super sweet and cuddly girl 🐶 who’s full of love and ready to share it. She’s looking for a supportive home where she can continue to grow, learn, and feel safe. Peanut would do especially well with a canine companion to keep her company, as she doesn’t like being left alone. She gets along wonderfully with smaller dog breeds and is gentle and loving with children ❤️

NAME: Hawke
TEXT: Hawke is a playful and happy boy 🐶, full of energy and confidence. He loves toys, gets excited easily, and brings joy wherever he goes! With a safe and slow introduction, Hawke has the potential to become best friends with your smaller dogs and even cats. He’s also great around young children, making him a fun and loving addition to a lively family. ❤️

NAME: Amber
TEXT: Amber is a gentle soul who may be a little shy at first 🐶, but with a warm and comforting home, she begins to shine. She blossoms with patience, support, and love ❤️, and would thrive best in a calm, peaceful environment. Older, understanding children would be a great match for her, helping her feel safe and supported as she builds confidence and truly comes into her own.

NAME: Jed
TEXT: Jed is a very handsome boy 🐶 with a playful spirit and a heart full of charm. He’s interactive and social, always ready to make new friends and spread good vibes. Confident yet a little goofy, Jed is easygoing and happy-go-lucky — the kind of companion who makes every moment more fun and lighthearted. ❤️

NAME: Queenie
TEXT: Queenie is a confident and loving soul 💖, radiating warmth wherever she goes. Her friendly, outgoing nature 🐾 makes her a joy to be around, and she thrives in social settings. Playful and engaging, Queenie brings happiness to every room she enters, leaving a lasting impression with her vibrant personality and boundless affection 🥰.

NAME: Walker
TEXT: Cats, birds, dogs, you name it, Sir Walker treats everyone big and small as a friend. Sweet boy Walker currently lives with cats and small dogs & is a very social & affectionate boy with people. He's also friendly with birds in a cage (see photo). He is soft and gentle around all of GAP's cats, small dogs and greyhounds making him a great addition to a multi-pet household with polite introductions to his new housemates. Walker is very affectionate, calm and an all round lovely boy who we can see fitting in to a home with or without children. He has been learning how to be inside the house and is so far going great! Reach out to the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Gem
TEXT: Young blue girl Gem is a gentle soul with a world of love to give – she’s just looking for the right person to help her shine. Gem loves children! This beautiful girl may be a little shy at first, but with time, patience, and a calm environment, she blossoms into a loyal and affectionate companion. Gem is the kind of dog who forms deep bonds with her people and rewards kindness with quiet devotion. She feels most at ease in the company of other greyhounds and would likely thrive in a home with a calm canine friend to show her the ropes. Gem is seeking a peaceful household without children, where she can settle into a predictable routine and feel safe. With the right support, Gem has so much potential – all she needs is a gentle heart and a soft place to land. If you are interested, please reach out the Western Sydney team.

NAME: Axel
TEXT: Axel is a sweet and sensitive greyhound who’s looking for a home where he can continue to build his confidence and thrive with a little guidance. While he’s not overly timid, he does best in a home that offers clear structure, routine, and patient support as he navigates the world. Axel is affectionate and eager to please, and once he settles in, he becomes a calm and loyal companion. He enjoys the company of other greyhounds and could do well with a confident dog buddy to help him feel at ease. Axel is best suited to a quieter household without young kids, where he can relax and grow at his own pace. With a supportive environment and consistent routine, Axel has all the right ingredients to become a happy, well-adjusted family member.

NAME: Dawn
TEXT: Say hello to Dawn! This bright, bubbly, and beautiful greyhound is ready to light up your life! Bursting with personality and affection, Dawn is the kind of dog who makes friends wherever she goes. She absolutely adores people and thrives on human connection, always up for a cuddle, a gentle walk, or just hanging out with her favourite humans. Dawn is polite on the leash and has shown she can be calm around small dogs from a respectful distance. She currently lives happily with other greyhounds and would fit beautifully into a home with another medium to large breed dog – or be just as happy soaking up all the love as your one and only. With her affectionate nature and easygoing charm, Dawn would make a fabulous family dog. She’s ready to bring joy, companionship, and a whole lot of tail wags to her forever home! Dawn is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Monica
TEXT: Meet Monica, a sweet and sociable girl with a heart of gold. This confident gal is friendly with everyone she meets and takes life in her stride with a calm and gentle nature. Monika is well-mannered on leash and happily shares her space with another greyhound and could be a lovely companion for a medium to large dog already in the home. Monica is the perfect fit for a variety of households, whether you're living in a townhouse, ground floor apartment (with lift access), or a home with a yard. She is quite adaptable and with the right home to provide her support, she is sure to thrive. Whether you're looking for a low-maintenance friend or a calm canine companion for your existing dog, Monica is ready to bring love and companionship into her forever home. If you are interested in learning more about Monica, reach out to the Western Sydney team.

NAME: Romeo
TEXT: Romeo, Romeo, wherefore art thou Romeo? Why I’m right here at Western Sydney! If you’ve been searching for your soul mate then look no further than gorgeous Romeo. Romeo is a gentle soul who loves love! Romeo has a goofy and charming personality! A gentleman by nature, he’s as graceful as he is affectionate. Whether it’s cuddling up for a quiet evening or running through the fields, Romeo is ready to share his world with you. We can guarantee this love story won’t end in tragedy...come down for a chance at love at first sight (hound)!

NAME: Patch
TEXT: Adorable and ultra cute, Patch can't wait to find his perfect home! Patch is a respectable young boy, who travels well, and has some experience around kids. His best home would be one with another m-l canine companion and a home without constant walkies around smaller breeds of dogs. Patch can be initially shy around new people and new areas but we know he will make an amazing and loyal pet! Patch is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Pixel
TEXT: If you're looking for a fun-loving greyhound who brings excitement and affection in equal measure, 1 year old little Miss Pixel could be the perfect fit for your family. Pixel is a bright and bubbly young greyhound who’s full of personality and always ready for fun! With her puppy-like energy and love for play, she’s the perfect match for an active family with kids. She currently lives with a staffy and gets along beautifully with other dogs, showing a mix of playful and respectful behaviours. Pixel would do well in a home that embraces her energy and provides structure, enrichment, and plenty of love. Pixel is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Tippy
TEXT: Tippy is a sweet, gentle soul who’s ready to find his forever home. He’s wonderful with kids of all ages (2–18), especially gentle-hearted girls, and absolutely adores playtime with his toys—he’ll happily bring the ball back for more! Tippy also enjoys soaking in his shell pool and lounging in the sun like a true chill king. He gets along well with pet fox terriers, is calm around aviary parrots, and has shown no reaction to cats—what a champ! Tippy is well-behaved, comes when called, and melts for pats and cuddles. He would be a perfect addition to a young family or a couple looking for a loyal best friend. Give Tippy your love and he’ll return it in spades.💙

NAME: Macca
TEXT: This is Macca! What a sweetheart; a friendly and happy girl who will steal your heart. Macca is full of fun and playfulness—she loves toys, playtime, walks, pats, cuddles, as well as quiet downtime with her humans. She's good with other dogs (including a labrador buddy) and would thrive with a loving family with older kids or with a couple who can give her the time, attention, and love she deserves. Macca is more than just a pet—she’s a loyal companion who will return your love tenfold. If you're looking for a devoted best friend with a wagging tail, a soft heart and a skip in her step, Macca's your girl!

NAME: Bernie
TEXT: **Bernie is in a foster care home with cats and older kids - check in soon for updates!** Bernie is friendly around dogs and cats here at the adoption centre! He enjoys being in the outdoors so a house with a backyard is preferred. Bernie can feel a bit overwhelmed when first going into new environments so we recommend a slow introduction to new things, however we've noticed he loves food and is already responding well to early training so we think he will thrive in a consistent home environment. He is a friendly boy who would be suitable around older kids. Bernie is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Joy
TEXT: *Joy has just gone in to a foster care home with a greyhound and a cavoodle - check in soon for updates!* Look at those sweet soulful eyes! Joy is a sweet senior girl full of cuteness and affection. She is well known for approaching anyone and everyone for some attention! She is great around calm dogs big or small. She likes chilled out dogs so if you have a calm canine companion, Joy would love to meet them. Joy is full of happiness, kindness & love. Joy is a senior lady but in no way does that slow her down. She is confident, engaging & playful. We think she would suit longer hours alone due to her laid back nature during alone time testing here at the adoption centre. Joy has grown up with smaller breeds of dogs, chickens, ducks & sheep around. If you're searching for two lovely ladies to join your family, Joy's sister Raven, is also available! Enquire with the Western Sydney adoption centre to meet Joy.

NAME: Bubbles
TEXT: Bubbles is a sweet, gentle and sooky adorable girl! Her friendly nature is something to see and we love hanging out with her! She is a friend to all, and we can't wait for someone to adopt her and experience the love we've seen here. Bubbles would love a courtyard or yard to bounce around, she has a laid back independent side which we see as she snoozes all day and is one of the most laid back hounds here at the adoption centre. Bubbles would love a home with a family who will treat her like the princess she is. Maybe you have kids who'd like a hound to grow up along side or a adventures and walking buddy, Bubbles is your girl. She can be adopted from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Julie
TEXT: Miss Julie is a playful, friendly girl who loves her toys, a run around with the other dogs (retired greyhounds and Jug), a splash in her clam shell pool and just being around people and quiet kids 10+, not too rambunctious. She's a bit of a character, loves to show off but she's not over the top, just a happy girl! At 6 she hasn't lost energy but slows down faster and rests longer, especially as she is learning the comforts of retired life! Julie has grown up on the farm and has come into town life ready for her new home. She has taken to a nice cosy bed on the floor and loves being on the patio as well on the warm nights. She would suit a quiet household, and someone with the time to get to know her, take her for a walk and have a bit of playtime in the morning, especially if you are going off to work. Some toys, an outdoor bed, pool, sandpit or another dog friend will keep her company for the day, plus plenty of rests. Someone home more often than not would be perfect. She's easy going and not worried by pet birds, cats or little fluffy dogs. Just a sweetheart ready to relish retired life. 💗

NAME: Goose
TEXT: Goose is, well, just a big goose! Only 32 kg, gentle and loves attention. He likes to wander around the sheds with his owner and visits the farm border collie who he loves to play with. He's a good traveller, no house experience, but was walked in town as a puppy. He's used to pottering about, but dreams of finding that comfy couch or spot in the garden, patio or verandah. He's friendly and happy to meet new people with a wag of his tail, loves a swim in the dam and loves his toys. He has been around kids 10+, and when you're not around to follow about, he is happy to amuse himself throwing his toys up in the air, especially his beloved soccer ball. Goose is a gentle, happy-go-lucky boy who would make a wonderful, loyal and easy going companion. Goose doesn't bark, except occasionally as a reminder for a bit of attention if you've stopped patting or when its dinner time! He lost 2 toes on his back left foot due to an injury as a puppy, which doesn't bother him, otherwise a healthy lad who has so much love to give. 💙

NAME: Yola
TEXT: Yola thrives on social interaction. She's a dynamo, always up for fun, whether it's dashing about or bursting into a sudden sprint. With her angelic demeanor and captivating eyes, she can charm her way out of any mischief she finds herself in. Yola would suit someone who is after a companion to cruise around with day-to-day but also chill out on the couch with.

NAME: Faith
TEXT: Given up on finding the perfect dog? Have a little faith! This happy excitable girl can't wait to bounce into your home! Faith is a good traveller, great in the car, friendly with people and dogs, and is great on the lead. She's a social and confident girl looking for a family with a townhouse/backyard, respectful kids who will enjoy play time, and a family who will include her in family life including walks and outings. Who are we to mess with faith? Enquire or Apply to Adopt this darling girl from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Dylan
TEXT: Meet Dylan—a true pocket rocket bursting with energy and enthusiasm for life! This fun-loving boy is always on the go, whether it’s heading out for a walk, sprinting around the yard in full zoomie mode, or playing endlessly with his favourite toys. Dylan thrives in a home that can match his pace and give him the physical and mental stimulation he craves. He’ll need an active household with a good-sized yard and experienced children who are confident around large, energetic dogs. While Dylan doesn’t show strong prey drive, he can be a bit too much for small breeds, so he’s best suited to homes with a robust, playful canine companion of similar size—pending a successful meet and greet. He’s a whirlwind of joy, curiosity, and excitement, and would make a wonderful addition to a family that embraces his zest for life and is ready for all the fun he brings

NAME: Sally
TEXT: Say hello to Sally—the life of the party and a greyhound full of bounce, joy, and endless fun! This playful girl loves her toys, lives for a good zoomie session, and thrives in an environment where she can stretch her long legs and let loose. Sally would love a home with a spacious yard and an active lifestyle to match her energy. She isn’t suited to homes with small animals but she’s a great match for other greyhounds or larger breeds who enjoy a good play session, pending a successful meet and greet. Sally is also a total sweetheart with people and doesn’t hold back on affection. Whether it’s leaning into a cuddle, joining in on family activities, or bringing her toy over for a game, she makes every moment fun and full of love. If you're looking for a lively, loving companion who will keep you smiling and moving, Sally might just be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Meet Missy, a gentle and sensitive soul with a quiet nature and a heart full of love to give. She’s looking for a peaceful home where she can take her time to settle in and truly be herself. Missy thrives in calm environments and would prefer a home without other pets—unless it’s another greyhound who shares her relaxed vibe. A yard where she can lounge in the sun or potter about at her own pace would be her dream come true. Once Missy feels safe and comfortable, her secret playful side begins to shine. She has a soft, endearing way of engaging with her people, showing affection and gentle joy that makes every moment with her special. If you're patient, kind, and ready to welcome a sweet girl who just needs a bit of time to bloom, Missy could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Julia
TEXT: Meet Julia, a gentle and affectionate 5-year-old female Greyhound with a heart full of love. She’s incredibly loyal and enjoys being close to her people—her favorite pastime is following her owner around the yard while he mows the lawn, just to be near him. Julia has a calm and sweet temperament that makes her a joy to have around, and she’s always up for some quiet companionship or a relaxing stroll. Julia is well-socialized and polite on walks, getting along well with other dogs she meets along the way. However, she prefers not to be around smaller animals, so a home without cats or small pets would be best. She’d thrive in a family environment, especially one with a yard where she can stretch out and soak up the sun. If you’re looking for a loving, devoted companion, Julia might just be the perfect match.

NAME: Pocket
TEXT: Pocket is a bouncy, fun little thing! She is very playful, hilarious and goofy, and will definitely make you laugh with her antics! Known for her cuddles, we love her here at the centre as she will snuggle right into you for a cuddle when you crouch down. She is very outgoing and affectionate, and we know someone will just love her for her silly cute personality. Due to her wiggly, bouncy nature we'd recommend older children in the home. This , adorable, affectionate girl is known for her love of toys and fun loving personality. She enjoys being indoors and would suit indoor living however access to a backyard or courtyard is recommended for her to get her energy out during the day. Pocket is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Kenneth
TEXT: Kenneth is a sweet gentle soul who is a darling on the lead and an overall laid back boy. Being middle aged, he's ready to take it easy and enjoy the retirement life. He's a friendly and affectionate boy who is suitable to live with respectful children or another M-L doggie pal. Suitable for a backyard/townhouse, this laid back boy suits many home types! He has the sweetest little face with an adorable personality to match. Come meet Kenneth at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Shadow
TEXT: Lurking in the shadows is this beautiful boy! Shadow is learning 'pet prep' in his current home, which includes spending time indoors, spending time with children, and small dogs! Having been around kids 10 years old and over, as well as 3 small dogs - Jack Russel, Pomeranian and Dachshund, he has perfected the art of the top 2 greyhound past times - playing and sleeping together. Shadow would be a wonderful addition to a family with dogs, children, and a townhouse/backyard for Shadow to enjoy spending time in. Shadow would enjoy being a member of the family and being included on walks, adventures, and cuddling watching TV at night. Shadow is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Naomi
TEXT: Naomi is a sweet & shy girl. She is suitable to live with other dogs including small dogs! Although initially shy, she is a brave girl who warms up well with consistent, gentle handling. Naomi would enjoy a quiet home with a grassy courtyard/backyard. She likes to keep to herself but travels well and is working on her confidence every day. If you're looking for a sweet and gentle hound who you can watch thrive with your nurturing personality, consider adopting Naomi. Naomi is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Mattie
TEXT: Maddie is a confident, social and playful hound. She is a funny and quirky girl who has been in the home, gone on trips to bunnings, hung around the kids at footy training and can be left in a yard on her own. She is great in the car.

NAME: Huckleberry
TEXT: This is Huckleberry 🐾 A sweet, playful boy ready to bring lots of fun and love into his new home! Huckleberry is super friendly, affectionate and loves to play. With the help of his favourite treats, Huckleberry picks up on training very quickly, showing he's not just a pretty face! If you’re home more often or have another medium to large dog, Huckleberry could fit right in! Whether you’re looking for a walking buddy or a happy face to greet you at the door, Huckleberry is your guy. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Dianne
TEXT: Diane is a sweet girl, she can take some time to warm up but is doing better every day! She loves her treats and can be won over easily with a pocket full of treats. She enjoys spending time with other greyhounds and would suit a forever home with another M-L canine companion. Her best suited home would be one in a quieter area, away from the hustle and bustle. She would enjoy a backyard or townhouse to lay in the sunshine. She can go up and down the stairs at the GAP centre and doesn't mind being left alone for a few hours, too. She is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Chief
TEXT: Meet Chief – a handsome, easy-going boy with a heart of gold. This laid-back fella is happy entertaining himself or just chillin' solo 😎. Patient and gentle, Chief is great with small children and gets along well with other animals. He grew up around a cattle dog and has been exposed to goats, so farm life is nothing new to him. Whether he's playing or relaxing in the sun, Chief brings a calm, loyal energy to any home 🐾.

NAME: Scout
TEXT: Scout is a playful and goofy greyhound who brings a sense of fun and adventure wherever he goes. His fun-loving nature, combined with his sweet personality, makes him an ideal companion for any family. Scout's zest for life ensures that there's never a dull moment when he's around. Scout's playful demeanor means he gets along well with people and other pets. His adventurous spirit makes him a great match for families who enjoy outdoor activities and playtime. Scout would thrive in a home that can match his playful spirit and provide plenty of opportunities for fun and adventure. A family that loves to play and explore will find a perfect companion in Scout. At the same time, his sweet nature means he also enjoys quiet moments of affection and relaxation.

NAME: Lyla
TEXT: Lyla is a delightful girl with a fun personality that is perfectly balanced by her sweet and gentle nature. Her vibrant ways and affectionate demeanor make her a favorite among everyone she meets. Lyla's charm and warmth are sure to bring joy to any household. Lyla's friendly and gentle nature means she gets along well with people and other dogs. She makes her a wonderful companion for families or individuals looking for an active yet loving friend. Lyla would thrive in a home where she can share her love and affection. A family that enjoys playtime and outdoor activities would be perfect for her. At the same time, she appreciates quiet moments of affection and will happily snuggle up for some downtime.

NAME: Pepper
TEXT: Pepper has a kind and gentle nature that instantly wins over everyone she meets. She’s easygoing, affectionate, and loves being part of the action, whether it’s with her human family or her fellow dog friends. Pepper’s playful yet calm demeanor makes her a joy to be around, and she’s ready to share her love with the lucky family who takes her home!

NAME: Dennis
TEXT: Dennis is a quiet, sweet, and gentle boy who is looking for a loving home that understands his shy nature. He thrives in a calm and stable environment where he can feel safe and secure. With a little patience and a lot of love, Dennis will blossom into a confident and happy companion. Dennis is great with other dogs, both big and small, making him a wonderful addition to a household with existing pets. His gentle demeanor ensures he gets along well with everyone he meets. Dennis would do best in a home that can provide him with plenty of love and encouragement. A calm setting will help him feel at ease and allow his true personality to shine.

NAME: Alvie
TEXT: Alvie is a delightful and sweet greyhound. He’s a shy boy who needs a loyal and loving friend to do life with. Once he has settled in, Alvies's personality shines through in everything he does, making him a delightful and loyal friend who is always ready to share his love. Alvies perfect home would be an experienced doggy handler who has the time to win his trust and help him to adjust to a new life 💕

NAME: Rex
TEXT: Rex is a handsome energetic and confident boy with a playful spirit and a heart full of love. He thrives on human companionship and will be a loyal shadow to his forever family—whether lying by your side, working alongside you, or joining in on daily adventures. Rex is housetrained, loves attention, and soaks up every pat and cuddle you can give. He would prefer to be the only dog in his new home, where its his time to soak up all the love. A large yard or acreage would be ideal for his zoomies, and he’s happiest with regular walks and space to run, then rest outside during the day for workers. Best suited to a home with an active person, couple or family with older kids (7+), someone home for some of the day, Rex is ready to bring joy, companionship and loyalty into your life. He's looking though the back door right now ready to come inside! 😍

NAME: Cassie
TEXT: Cassie is a stunning white hound with a fawn patch or two, making her not only eye catching, but very unique! This 4 year old girl is confident and affectionate with new people and would be suitable around respectful children. She would suit a home with other medium to large dogs in the home, and a backyard to enjoy exploring and sniffing. Cassie is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Pete
TEXT: For Pete's sake, look at this handsome boy! Pete is a shy and reseved boy looking for a calm, low stimulus home to enjoy his retirement. Pete would do best without children and would love a backyard to retreat to when things get too busy for him. Pete is a delight around other greyhounds and gains confidence around them. A nurturing and relaxed owner would suit him the best. We think he would love to either live with another greyhound and/or continue socialisation around other dogs. Pete is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ivy
TEXT: Meet Ivy, an energetic & affectionate girl looking for her forever home. Ivy is toilet trained, good on floorboards, carpet, stairs, the elevator and enjoys a ride in the car, but can be a little shy with dogs on walks. Ivy is currently in a foster care home where her daily routine includes two long walks and a shorter evening stroll, ensuring she gets the exercise she needs to stay happy and healthy. Ivy is a devoted cuddler on the couch, absolutely loving playtime with her favourite stuffed toys. Ivy would do best in a fully fenced townhouse or backyard, where she can relax during the day and do her zoomies. Ivy is a perfect companion for an active family with plenty of space to run and play. While Ivy thrives on walks and playtime, she's also a calm, adaptable dog who would happily fit into the routine of a family with full-time working parents with a canine companion. A canine or feline companion would be a wonderful addition to her life, allowing her to be entertained by her doggie friend. If you're interested in Ivy, contact GAP Londonderry or fill out an application and mention her name to meet her today!

NAME: Lloyd
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Lloyd! 💙 Lloyd may be a little shy when meeting new people, but with a supportive and understanding family, he quickly blossoms into a confident, happy, and loving boy. 🐶 Smart and full of potential, Lloyd is just waiting for the right people to help him shine. If you're looking for a sweet companion who’ll grow into your best buddy, Lloyd is ready to meet you! 💫

NAME: Flick
