TEXT: 🐾 Meet Flick! 🐶💛 Flick is a happy-go-lucky lady with a gentle soul and a love for life (and treats!). 🍖 She’s playful, sweet, and has a calm nature that makes her wonderful around small and young children. She’s spent time indoors and even had some exposure to farm life—including goats! 🐐 Whether she’s enjoying cuddle time or playtime, Flick’s joyful spirit shines through. Looking for a loving, easygoing companion? Flick might just be your perfect match! 💕

NAME: Flow
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Flow! 🌸 Flow is a very sweet girl with a heart full of potential. 💕 She's ready to learn, grow, and succeed with the help of a loving, supportive home. With a little training and plenty of encouragement, she’ll blossom into an amazing companion. She’d do best with older, understanding children and could be a great match for a calm, medium-large dog friend. If you're looking for a kind soul to grow with, Flow is ready to start her journey with you! 🐶💫

NAME: Jasper
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Jasper! 💙 Jasper is an affectionate, sweet, and kind-hearted boy who just wants to be loved. 🐶 He’s playful and gentle, with so much potential to shine in the right home. He’s still learning and will need a supportive family to continue his training and help build his confidence. Jasper would do best with older, understanding children and could get along well with a compatible medium-large dog. If you're ready to open your heart to a truly lovable companion, Jasper is waiting for you! 💕

NAME: Reggie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Reggie! 🐶 Reggie is an active, playful, and seriously handsome boy! 😍 He's full of energy and would love a yard where he can run, play, and burn off that puppy spirit. Still working on his manners, Reggie needs a patient, understanding family ready to guide him with love and consistency. He’d do best with older kids and could be a great match for a friendly medium-large dog buddy. If you’re looking for a fun-loving companion to grow with, Reggie’s your guy! 💙

NAME: Emma
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Emma! 💖 Emma is a gentle soul with so much love to give. She may be a little shy at first, but with patience and kindness, her sweet personality shines through. 💕 She’s looking for a calm, supportive family to help her grow in confidence with continued training and socialisation. Emma enjoys the company of well-mannered dogs (especially larger ones!) and would do best with older, understanding children. A secure yard to play and explore would be the cherry on top for this lovely girl. 🐶🌿

NAME: Jodie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Jodie! 💕 Jodie is a sweet, goofy girl with a big heart and an even bigger personality! 💖 She’s bursting with playful energy and would love a yard where she can zoom around and enjoy all her favorite games. Jodie is still learning the ropes, so she’ll need a patient, loving home committed to helping her grow with consistent training and gentle guidance. 🐶 She’d thrive with older, understanding kids and could do well with a medium-large dog friend who matches her vibe. If you’re ready to laugh, play, and love a little extra every day—Jodie’s your girl! 💕

NAME: Benson
TEXT: Meet Benson – A Gentle Giant with a Heart Full of Love 💙🐾 Benson is a sweet, kind-hearted boy who’s still finding his way in the world. This gentle giant is looking for a calm, supportive home where he can grow in confidence, surrounded by patience, understanding, and lots of love. He’ll need ongoing training and encouragement, but with the right guidance, Benson will blossom into the most loyal companion. He’s suitable to live with medium to large dogs who are calm and respectful, and would do best with older, understanding children who can give him the space and gentleness he needs. If you have a little extra room in your home—and your heart—Benson might just be the perfect fit. 💛

NAME: Ducky
TEXT: Meet Ducky – A Sweet, Gentle Soul Ready for Her Cozy Forever Home 🐾💗 Ducky is a loving, affectionate older girl who’s all about the cuddles and calm vibes. She’s looking for a slower-paced home where she can enjoy the quiet life with people who appreciate the beauty of a relaxed routine. Ducky would love a family with older, understanding children, and she’s suitable to live with medium to large dogs who are respectful and calm like her. If you're after a sweet companion who just wants to be loved and lounge by your side, Ducky might be your perfect match 🐾💗

NAME: Goofy
TEXT: Meet Goofy – A Special Boy Looking for His Special Home 🐶💛 Goofy is a sweet male with a quirky charm and a heart ready to bond. He’s looking for a quiet, patient home where he can take things at his own pace. Goofy needs someone who understands that dogs like him need time, gentle guidance, and a whole lot of love to build trust. He’s still learning about the world, so training and socialization will be key to helping him grow into his best self. Goofy would do best as the only dog in the home, with older, understanding children who can respect his boundaries. With the right people, Goofy will shine – could that be you?

NAME: Sofia
TEXT: Meet Sofia – A Loving Blue Beauty Looking for Her Forever Home 💙🐾 Sofia is a beautiful blue female with a gentle soul and a heart full of potential. She's looking for a home that can offer her support, understanding, and time—someone patient and committed to helping her grow with continued training and care. Sofia has an old injury to her front leg, so she’ll need a family that understands her physical needs and can help her feel safe and comfortable. She thrives best as a single dog in the household and would be happiest with older, dog-savvy children who can respect her space and needs. If you’re ready to offer a calm, loving home where Sofia can continue her journey, she’s ready to meet you. 💙

NAME: Royal
TEXT: Meet Royal! The King of Cuddles and Playtime! 🐾 If you're looking for a loyal companion who’s both noble and a bit goofy, Royal is ready to bring you love, fun and lots of personality. This charming greyhound enjoys his toys and loves to play! Royal walks beautifully on lead and adores his daily walks. He's polite around smaller dogs but would prefer to share his kingdom with a medium or large canine companion. Ready to give Royal his happily ever after? Come and meet this beautiful boy at Western Sydney...he’s been waiting for his crowning moment! 👑

NAME: Snippy
TEXT: Snippy is a relaxed, easy-going boy who’s active without being jumpy and a dream on the lead. One of the friendliest greyhounds his owner has met, he’s super social, affectionate, and loves spending time with people - he just adores the grandkids aged 6 and up! Snippy’s confident, happy nature makes him an excellent pet for anyone. He’s great with other greys, mingled with the farm cat, and not bothered by the labradoodle next door. He doesn’t chase kangaroos or sheep in the paddock, or chickens in a pen near his yard, and he’s fine being on his own if needed. He loves his daily walks, swimming adventures, and is very food-motivated—making him a breeze to train. Snippy currently sleeps on the verandah but would be just as happy curled up indoors. He’d thrive in a home with someone who has time to hang out with him. This sweet, easy-going boy is ready to bring love, fun, and loyalty to his forever home. Snippy is a rare find. 💥

NAME: Conrad
TEXT: *Hi, I'm in foster care! I'm available to adopt - reach out to the team!* Foster Update - he is a gentle, sweet, little old man who is a quiet observer...more foster update below: 🐾 Conrad is truly a sweet and gentle boy who is very affectionate 🐾 He doesn’t bark, whinge or whine 🐾 He comes when called & he loves being wherever you are 🐾 Suitable for full time hours, stays outdoors during that time 🐾 He comes across as an old man, quiet and observant 🐾 Conrad won't get up on couches 🐾 Sleeps outside at night quietly and doesn't mind the possums 🐾 He likes walks & is OK with sirens, busy roads 🐾 Happy walking past junior rugby & groups of children 🐾 Great on doggie dates with other greyhounds 🐾 Learning to enjoy road trips 🐾 Tolerant of wild life & birds in the yard 🐾 The birds can have pool parties in his water bowl and will share his kibble with magpies! 🐾 Spent time with 12-14 year old kids who are dog savvy (who he chose to spend 'quiet time' on the floor with!) 🐾 Grown so much in confidence & is ready for his forever home! Conrad is a quiet natured, reserved yet affectionate boy. He is polite meeting other big or small dogs when out and about but would suit a home willing to take things slow while he learns about the world around him. He could happily co exist with another doggie with a similar gentle temperament. Conrad is enjoying foster care and has become so confident in new environments but will still require a patient home. Conrad is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre to meet him & his amazing foster carers.

NAME: Poh
TEXT: Poh is a sweet well balanced boy. He will engage in playing fetch, quick zoom in the yard followed by some serious lounging around. He is good with kids and all dogs. He lives in a semi rural area and is familiar with native wildlife coming round like roos, wombats and native birds.

NAME: Buster
TEXT: Buster is a beautiful social boy, he gets along with all dog breeds and sizes. He lives on the south coast and has been visited by various native animals. He is happy to play in the yard, relax on his own or go out for a small adventure to Bunnings or the beach.

NAME: Tracey
TEXT: Tracey is a loving girl with a heart of gold and a very special talent—leaning! If you're standing still, she'll gently lean in close, just to let you know she loves you. Affectionate and calm, Tracey is happiest when she’s near her people. She’s great with other dogs, big or small, and absolutely adores children. Tracey is the kind of dog who fits right in and makes everyone feel at ease. Let’s be honest—everyone knows a girl called Tracey… so maybe it’s time you had one of your own! 💕🐾

NAME: George
TEXT: George is a calm and loyal boy who just loves to be by your side. He’s the kind of dog who’ll follow you around the house, not because he needs anything—he just likes to know what’s going on! A bit of a sticky beak, George is always curious and quietly watching the world around him. He’s great with dogs of all shapes and sizes and absolutely adores children. With his gentle nature and friendly personality, George makes a perfect family companion or best buddy for someone who wants a loving shadow. If you're after a sweet, loyal boy who will stick close and make every day brighter, George is ready to join your pack! 🐾🧡

NAME: Felix
TEXT: Felix is a chilled-out charmer who’s just happy to be part of the fun. He’s quiet, calm, and has a super relaxed nature—nothing really bothers him! Whether it's hanging out with other dogs or being around kids, Felix fits right in. He’s friendly, gentle, and goes with the flow. This sweet boy doesn’t have a care in the world—he’s just looking for a comfy spot, some love, and maybe a snack or two. Felix is the kind of dog who brings a little bit of sunshine into every day without ever asking for much in return. If you’re after a gentle, low-fuss companion who gets along with everyone, Felix might just be your perfect match. 🐾💙

NAME: Tylah
TEXT: Tylah is a beautiful, gentle soul who’s mastered the art of relaxing. She’s a laid-back lady who loves her naps and cozy spots, but don’t let that fool you—she still has her zoomie moments! Short bursts of energy are her specialty, followed by lots of lounging and cuddles. She’s happiest when she’s with her people, always close by and ready to share her calm, loving presence. Loyal, sweet, and full of quiet charm, Tylah is the kind of companion who makes every day feel a little more peaceful. If you're looking for a loyal, low-maintenance best friend who will love being by your side (especially on the couch), Tylah might just be the perfect match. 💕

NAME: Digger
TEXT: Digger is a curious, affectionate boy who loves to learn and be involved in whatever you're doing. He’s attentive, enjoys playing with his toys, and thrives on interaction. Digger would do best as the only dog in the home and would love having older children to play and bond with.

NAME: Brad
TEXT: Brad is a lively, energetic boy once he feels at home. He enjoys playtime, especially in a backyard where he can stretch his legs and have fun. Brad is good with smaller dogs and would do well in a home with older children. A sweet, active companion ready for his next adventure!

NAME: Rafiki
TEXT: Rafiki is a lively, energetic boy with an incredible love for toys! He’s a one-dog fetch machine—happily tossing his own toys just to chase them down again. Social, interactive, and full of fun, Rafiki brings playful energy and joy wherever he goes.

NAME: Dempsey
TEXT: Dempsey is a fun-loving, affectionate boy with a big personality and an even bigger love for his toys. He's interactive, silly, and always ready to make you laugh with his goofy antics. Dempsey does well with smaller dogs and cats after a slow, safe introduction. A joyful companion who’s all about play, cuddles, and good vibes!

NAME: Zazu
TEXT: Zazu is a gentle male who takes a little time to settle in, but once he's comfortable, his playful and funny personality shines through. He absolutely loves his toys and enjoys exploring his surroundings with curiosity. Zazu gets along well with smaller dogs and cats after a slow, safe introduction. A sweet soul with a goofy side, he’s sure to bring joy and laughter to a patient and loving home.

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Jack is a such a sweet, affectionate soul who’s never raced and was born and raised in a gentle, loving environment. Recently, Jack had the chance to live in a foster home for a month — with both big (Maremma, Great Dane x) and small dogs (Jack Russell) — and he settled in right away, slept through his first night with no fuss, and proved he’s just as good inside as he is out. This boy is the definition of easy-going. Whether he's snoozing on a cozy rug in an enclosed patio or quietly sniffing around the garden, Jack is all about the slow life. He’s a gentle, lazy wanderer who enjoys the simple things: a bit of sun, a bit of shade, and a lot of love. He enjoys the car for outings and is unfazed in new environments A perfect gentleman, Jack would make a wonderful companion for retirees or families with older kids in a quiet, relaxed environment. He'd love someone to be home to poke about with but doesn't require daily walks if has playtime in yard and attention.

NAME: Holly
TEXT: Holly is a delightful bubbly little girl, loves pats, cuddles and playing with kids 5+, small dogs and big dogs, from a mini groodle to a Rottweiler, running around with them and sleeping next to them. She loves walks and is easy on the lead, even on busy streets. Holly has been living inside and is nearly housetrained, also crate-trained to sleep at night. She loves all people, kids, other dogs and cats. She is calm and affectionate as well as a playful social butterfly, happy to sit, be patted and admired at your local café. Holly would make a beautiful, loving and cuddly companion. *Holly needs to be fed separately from other dogs at mealtimes as she doesn't like sharing her food with other dogs.

NAME: Horsey
TEXT: Horsey is an incredible work of art. He is a sculpted magnificent looking retired athlete. He does enjoy a play and a run. He does wipe out pretty quick like most sprinters once he has moved and will relax nicely. He is a gentle boy who loves everyone, he is a social and confident boy.

NAME: Daisy
TEXT: Daisy is a lovely hound, she is very social, confident and friendly. She is great around everybody and will make an excellent addition to your life. She is good on the lead and great company.

NAME: Ella
TEXT: This sweetest girl could be all yours! A beautiful, calm, gentle and affectionate little girl, Ella is the perfect fit for any family, couple or retirees that have time to be with her. She loves company, being close to you and being part of your daily life. She loves kids 3-5+ and meeting everyone, pats and cuddles welcome! Ella has been living inside where she likes to lie on her bed, not fazed about the resident cat, mini Groodle and kelpie pup, also small kids 3+, a labrador and other retired greyhounds. Small quiet dogs preferred, loves paying with the lab. She loves a run and play in the yard, walks and being around her family; home workers or retirees would be perfect. Otherwise Ella is such an easy-going girl, just has FOMO when kids are playing or something is going on she just has to be part of it. FOMO! She is super friendly, fun, playful and loves life; she would make yours a happy one, too. 🧡

NAME: Garry
TEXT: Garry is a true companion and ready to become anyone’s best friend. Garry is 4 years of age and has grown up in a residential home whilst also living with other greyhounds. Garry enjoys his daily walk around town and makes friends with the neighbourhood children and dogs on his walk. With the correct introduction Garry could he suited to younger children and would be amazing in a townhouse or apartment with a walk everyday.

NAME: Blue
TEXT: Blue is a friendly and loyal boy who loves meeting new people with lots of enthusiasm! He greets everyone with gusto and is always happy to make new human friends. When it comes to dogs, Blue prefers medium to large breed pals and needs a good introduction, as he can get quite excited at first. He’s not a fan of small dogs, so he’d do best in a home with larger dog friends. If you’re looking for a loyal, lively companion who loves people and is ready to be part of the fun, Blue could be the perfect fit!

NAME: Rockstar
TEXT: Rockstar is the coolest, most laid-back guy around! Just like his name, he’s a chilled-out rockstar who loves attention and enjoys hanging out with people—especially kids. He’s great with all dogs and loves to play, making him the perfect companion for a fun-loving household. Rockstar is as friendly as they come and always ready to be part of the action. If you’re looking for a relaxed, happy, and playful buddy who’s always ready for some fun, Rockstar is your guy!

NAME: Queeny
TEXT: Queeny is a happy, very lovable and friendly young girl who loves life! She would be a great addition for a young couple or family with older kids on her own or with another greyhound or medium to large dog. She just wants to be part of your life, be a sticky beak, play, and have fun! She can also settle down and have a rest when needed, inside or out in a large yard. She has been around a lot of people coming and going in an office environment, noises don't worry her. Queeny loves to wander around the yard and play, then sleep inside with other retired greys during the day or in her own indoor kennel. She is used to walking on lead, loves pats and is well-behaved when given love and attention. She would adore a new home to settle into with her own special people be your loyal companion. 🥰

NAME: Pretty
TEXT: Meet Pretty! 💖 Personality: Sweet, friendly, and happy! Pretty in name and nature!!!! Pretty is a gentle, sweet-natured girl who is friendly with everyone she meets—both people and dogs! She’s quick to settle and enjoys a relaxed, calm environment. Her lovely personality makes her the perfect companion for a variety of homes. If you’re looking for a happy and easy-going dog with a heart full of love, Pretty could be the one for you!

NAME: Bruce
TEXT: Meet Bruce! 🖤 Bruce is a sweet, laid-back boy with a charming personality. He gets along well with small dogs and is always happy to spend time with his human friends. Bruce does have pannus, a condition that affects his eyes. While it's not curable, it’s easily managed with treatment to keep him comfortable. If you’re looking for a friendly, easy-going companion with a big heart, Bruce is ready to bring his charm into your life!

NAME: Sonny
TEXT: Sonny is a strong, happy, and fun-loving boy who adores people and loves to play! He’s always up for some fun with his favorite toys—he absolutely loves them and could play all day. Sonny gets along great with medium to large breed dogs and would be happiest with a female dog friend. He’d also love to have a yard where he can run and play to his heart’s content. If you’re looking for an energetic and toy-obsessed companion with a heart full of love, Sonny might just be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Venus
TEXT: Venus is a beautiful, independent lady who is an absolute delight to have around. She’s perfectly happy relaxing on her own but still enjoys some attention and pats when you're nearby. She’s been socialised with small dogs and, while she’s not overly interested in them, she’s calm and well-behaved in their company. If you're looking for a sweet, low-maintenance companion who enjoys both quiet time and a little love, Venus could be the one for you! She may be nearly 8 years old but she still has lots of love to share.

NAME: Matty
TEXT: Matty is a relaxed and happy boy who loves nothing more than a pat and a tasty treat! He’s very friendly and has been socialised with small dogs, making him a lovely companion for a variety of homes. With his calm nature and sweet personality, Matty is the kind of dog who just wants to hang out, enjoy your company, and maybe sneak an extra snack or two! If you’re looking for an easy-going buddy with a big heart, Matty’s your guy.

NAME: Cia
TEXT: Meet Cia! 💙 Cia may be nearly 8, but she’s young at heart and full of love! She’s a happy, friendly girl who enjoys the simple things in life—like a short walk, a comfy bed, and a ride in the car (one of her favourite things!). Cia is social with other dogs and gets along best with large breeds or calm small dogs. She’s easy-going and loves being part of the action, but also knows how to relax and take it easy. Cia thinks an apartment would be fine as long as she does not have to walk up and down stairs. If you’re after a sweet and gentle companion who still has a spring in her step, Cia could be the perfect match!

NAME: Jethro
TEXT: Meet Jethro 🐾 Jethro is a quiet, easy-going boy who just needs a little time to show his sweet side. At first, he might come across as a bit of a sad sack—but don’t let that fool you! He’s loving, gentle, and really enjoys a good pat and some one-on-one time. While Jethro is usually calm, he can get a bit excited when meeting small dogs for the first time. The good news is he does settle down once he’s had a moment. If you’re after a laid-back companion with a soft heart and soulful eyes, Jethro could be the perfect match for you.

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Bob is a handsome, happy, and playful boy who’s full of personality! He loves life and enjoys being around people and other dogs—especially other greyhounds. Bob is strong and can get a little overexcited around small dogs, so he’d do best in a home without them. He would love to live with a medium to large female dog, or he’d be just as happy as the only dog in the home. If you’re looking for a fun-loving companion with a big heart and a beautiful brindle coat, Bob could be your perfect match!

NAME: Be
TEXT: Be is a sweet and friendly boy who loves going for walks and spending time with his people. At just 2 years old, he’s still full of playful energy and curiosity about the world! He’s been introduced to small dogs, but can be a bit too bouncy for them—so he’d do best with a medium to large dog buddy who can match his playful style. Be would really love a home with a secure yard where he can stretch out, relax, and enjoy the sunshine between walks. He’s ready to bring lots of love, tail wags, and fun to his forever home!

NAME: Strawberry
TEXT: Meet Strawberry, a quiet and calm greyhound with a wonderfully laid-back and easy-going nature. She’s patient and gentle, making her a dream companion for a peaceful home. Best suited as a single dog household, Strawberry is cat workable and has experience living indoors, so she’s already familiar with home life. A sweet soul looking for a calm place to call her own.

NAME: Wolfie
TEXT: Wolfie is the sweetest older gentleman you will ever meet! At 8 years old, he still has plenty of life and love to give. With his soft demeanor and loving nature, Wolfie is the perfect companion for anyone seeking a loyal and affectionate friend. He has a calm and soothing presence, making him an ideal pet for a any household. His loving and affectionate nature means he enjoys cuddles and spending quality time with his human family. Wolfie is a delight to be around, always ready to offer a comforting nuzzle. He has been living with a Cavoodle and is good with other dogs both big and small.

NAME: Brooke
TEXT: Introducing Brooke! A gentle soul with the sweetest nature you could hope for. She is super sweet and affectionate, with a nice gentle personality. Quiet and loving, she adores human connection, happily leaning in for cuddles and trotting over when called. Brooke is the kind of companion who will quietly fill your days with warmth, love, and loyalty. With her gentle personality, Brooke could thrive in an apartment setting, especially with a patient and understanding family who can give her the time and support she needs to settle in. Shorter hours alone during the first few weeks will see Brooke settle into pet life. She walks nicely on the lead and does well on walkies. She does well on walks with other big and small dogs but would prefer not to share her home with them at this stage. Brooke is available through our Western Sydney Adoption Centre.

NAME: Rowdy
TEXT: Meet Rowdy! The handsome social butterfly with a heart full of love and a nose for treats! This confident and friendly guy absolutely adores people and will charm his way into your heart (and maybe your snack stash) in no time. Rowdy is super trainable and eager to learn, especially if food or toys are involved – a home that is interested in furthering his training and development is ideal Rowdy is still learning the ropes when it comes to other animals, so he’s best suited as a solo dog or with another greyhound friend who can help him find his groove. He’d thrive in a home with a yard to explore and a family who can support him through his transition to pet life. With a little guidance and a lot of love, Rowdy will be the ultimate loyal companion – cheeky, charming, and full of fun. Rowdy is available through our Western Sydney Adoption Centre.

NAME: Blaze
TEXT: Meet this laid-back, placid boy—our sweet male Blaze! He's the definition of a "dopey" cuddle bug who loves nothing more than a good snuggle. As a single dog household pup, he's very content with his quiet life in the backyard, and he's happy to share his space with older children who understand his calm nature. Experienced owners will appreciate his lazy demeanor and gentle temperament. He’s all about relaxing and enjoying the simple things in life!

NAME: Dusty
TEXT: Dusty is a fun and playful greyhound with a heart full of love, a social butterfly who would love to be your next companion. He has a cheeky personality that makes everyone smile. His playful antics and affectionate nature make him a joy to be around. Dusty enjoys his daily walks and will be sure to curl up next to you for some quality cuddle time when the walk is done. Dusty is curious and loves to explore new places. Whether it’s a walk in the park or a hike in nature, he’s always up for an adventure. If you’re looking for a fun, loving, and goofy companion, Dusty is the perfect greyhound for you! 🐾

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Jack is a friendly, happy-go-lucky greyhound who’s always up for an adventure! He’s 4 1/2 years old and loves going for walks around the neighborhood, especially in suburban areas where there’s lots to sniff and explore. 🌳 This guy is also a big fan of the beach, with a special love for small shell pools—he’s happiest splashing around and enjoying the water! 🌊 Jack is great with other dogs and always ready to make new friends. His sweet, friendly nature makes him a joy to be around. Whether he’s on a walk or just chilling, Jack is sure to bring a smile to anyone he meets! 😊 If you’re looking for a fun, friendly companion who loves the outdoors, Jack is the perfect buddy for you! 🐕💖

NAME: Santa
TEXT: Santa Clause is coming to your lounge! Santa is a handsome 4 year old boy who is looking to be your perfect companion. Santa takes a little bit to warm up to new people but when he is comfortable he's the perfect mix of cuddly and playful. During the day Santa is perfect for fulltime workers as he spends his day sleeping and playing in the backyard. By night time You'll find Santa dreaming whilst curled up on the lounge or your bed with family or your other large fluffy companion.

NAME: Plucky
TEXT: Plucky is a friendly and independent greyhound with a charming personality! She loves spending time in her kennel and lounging on her bed, making her a cozy and content companion. With her plucky attitude, she’s full of confidence and doesn't mind doing her own thing. While she enjoys being around people, she also appreciates her personal space. If you're looking for a laid-back but lovable dog with a bit of spunk, Plucky is the perfect match!

NAME: Pepper
TEXT: Looking for a spicy, high-energy pup to add some heat to your life? With her bold confidence and zest for adventure, Pepper will keep you on your toes and bring endless fun to your days. Whether it’s a brisk walk in the park, a game of fetch, or a playful romp with her doggy friends, Pepper’s always up for action and excitement. Her enthusiasm is contagious, and there’s never a dull moment with this fiery girl around! Pepper is confident, sociable, and loves to have a good time, especially with medium to large dogs who can match her energy. If you're looking for a fun-loving, playful companion to join in your outdoor adventures and keep the excitement rolling, Pepper’s the one for you! She’s the perfect addition to an active home where she can burn off some of that spicy energy and steal your heart with her fiery personality. Ready for a hot new addition to your family? Pepper can’t wait to meet you at the Western Sydney Facility!

NAME: Simon
TEXT: Simon is a charming hound, he does like to stretch his legs with a morning zoomie and fetching toys. He burns himself almost straight away and enjoys being a lazy hound. He is a good mix of being an active hound that likes to relax also.

NAME: Dusty (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Howdy, partner! Name’s Dusty, and I’m a handsome greyhound lookin’ to saddle up and make some memories with ya! 🤠 I’m a social cowboy, friendly with folks and always up for a good ol’ chinwag. I get along great with medium and large dogs, and with a bit of further training and a meet-and-greet, I could be rustlin' up some friendships with smaller breeds too! 🐾 Now, I’m not one to turn down a good meal — I’m mighty food motivated! If you’ve got some tasty treats or a fun toy in your pocket, I’ll be the best partner-in-crime you could ask for! 🍖🎾 I’m also used to my crate, so I know when it’s time to rest in my own little space, but I’ll be rarin' to go when you’re ready for some fun! If you’re lookin' for a loyal, friendly companion with a heart as big as the Wild West, I’d be thrilled to join your posse. Let’s make this ride a whole lot more fun, partner! 🤠🌵

NAME: Maximo
TEXT: Maximo is a sporty and fun-loving greyhound with a passion for water and a heart full of love. Whether he’s splashing around in the pool or running around with his greyhound buddies, he’s always up for an active, fun time. Maximo is also fantastic with kids, having spent time with young ones and showing nothing but patience and gentleness. His easy-going nature and friendly demeanor make him a perfect fit for a family looking for a loving, playful companion. Maximo is also open to living with other dogs, especially fellow greyhounds, and has the potential to coexist with small dogs and cats with the right training and introductions, and pending a meet and greet. His calm and cooperative attitude will make him a great addition to your home. If you’re looking for a sporty, fun, and affectionate dog who’s ready to join your team, Maximo could be the perfect match! Come meet him and see why he’s ready to take your home to the next level!

NAME: Ruby (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi, I'm Ruby, I'm pretty and petite like my gemstone name. I have a placid & quiet nature. I’m a sweet middle aged hound looking for a family who will love me forever. I love being indoors on my comfy bed and would be glad to live in an apartment or unit. I am quite happy spending some time alone snoozing the day away while you're away as long as you live in a quiet neighbourhood so i can enjoy my beauty rest. I would like a home with calm kids and calm dogs so I can enjoy the quiet life with you. Like all greyhounds, I do have a little burst of energy and will zoom around and play with my toys, but don’t worry as soon as I’m finished you will find me in bed or laying in the sun. Oh, and did I mention I love food? I love learning new things as long as there are treats involved and the GAP humans say I am very smart. If you think this I could be suited to your home then apply to meet me today at our Londonderry site.

NAME: Sam (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Looking for a fun-loving, people-obsessed companion? Sam the greyhound is your guy! 🐾 With his playful personality and endless enthusiasm, he’s ready to steal your heart and bring joy to every adventure. Sam is a total people pleaser, always eager for his human's attention and affection. He’s incredibly social and loves to be around his people, making him the perfect companion for anyone looking for a friendly, outgoing dog. Sam is also pro when it comes to car rides—he loves hopping in for a fun adventure and travels like a champ. Whether it’s exploring new environments or playing with his favorite toys, Sam is always up for the next exciting thing! He’s also a big fan of walks, where his playful, excitable personality shines. Sam is suitbale for living with other dogs around his size and would also be happy to share his home with older kids. If you’re looking for a fun, loving, and energetic pup to share your life with, Sam is your guy! 🐕💙 Contact the Western Sydney team to meet Sam today!

NAME: Bertha
TEXT: Bertha is a playful, cheeky, and energetic female greyhound who loves people and is very social. She’s curious and full of fun, always ready for an adventure. With the right introduction, she might get along with smaller dogs, making her a great addition to an active and engaging home.

NAME: Collie
TEXT: Collie is a sweet older female with a calm, relaxed, and easy-going nature. She’s happy to please and would thrive in a slower-paced home. Older children are best for her, and she’s fine with smaller dogs and cats, making her a wonderful companion for a peaceful and loving household.

NAME: Billy
TEXT: Billy is a sweet, affectionate, and kind natured boy. He’s loving and enjoys playing with toys, often collecting them on his bed. Billy is interactive and gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs, making him a fun and friendly companion.

NAME: Dare
TEXT: Dare is a big, gentle giant with a very sweet and playful nature. He’s fun-loving yet shows a patient and calm side when needed. Confident and happy, Dare is the perfect mix of energy and tranquility, making him an affectionate companion for any home.

NAME: Windy
TEXT: Windy is a very sweet-natured male dog who can be a little shy at first but quickly comes out of his shell, especially when playing with toys. Confident on his own, he gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs and is sure to bring joy and warmth once he settles in.

NAME: Hank
TEXT: Hank is a calm, easy-going, and very friendly dog with an affectionate and interactive nature. He loves to connect with others and is great with smaller breeds of dogs. Hank’s gentle personality makes him a wonderful companion for any home looking for a sweet and sociable pet.

NAME: Tom
TEXT: Tom is a happy boy who thrives on his own in a single-dog household. He needs a supportive home where he can grow and learn. With patience and encouragement, Tom will blossom into a loving and confident companion.

NAME: Scotch
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Scotch! 🖤 Scotch is a happy, confident greyhound with a heart full of joy. Due to a past leg injury, he enjoys a slower-paced home and shorter walks—but don’t worry, he can still move around and play just fine! 🐾 Engaging, affectionate, and full of love, Scotch thrives in a calm environment where he can relax and enjoy life at his own pace. If you're looking for a gentle, loyal companion, Scotch is ready to win your heart. 💕

NAME: Uno
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Uno! 🌟 Uno is a lovely older lady with a confident, engaging personality and a heart full of love. 💕 She’s sweet, kind, and always happy—bringing a warm, joyful presence wherever she goes. With her calm nature and affectionate spirit, Uno makes the perfect companion for a caring, loving family ready to share their home with a gentle soul. 🐶💫 If you’re looking for a steady, loving friend, Uno is ready to make your heart her home.

NAME: Dozer
TEXT: Dozer, or "Little D," is a sweet boy who needs time and patience to learn and grow. He’ll thrive in a quiet home where he can feel safe and supported as he blossoms into his best self. With the right care, he’s sure to become a loving companion.

NAME: Milo
TEXT: Milo is a fun-loving male greyhound with a playful and confident personality. He’s happy, sweet-natured, and kind, making him a loving companion for any home. Milo’s cheerful attitude and affectionate nature are sure to bring joy to those around him.

NAME: Lexi
TEXT: Lexi is a sweet and placid female greyhound with a calm demeanor. Eager to learn, she needs room to grow and thrive, along with patience and understanding. A single-dog household would be ideal, providing her with the space and care she needs to flourish.

NAME: Aggi
TEXT: Aggi is a pretty female greyhound who can be a little shy at first. She needs encouragement, support, love, and time to grow. A single-dog household would be ideal, where she can feel secure and receive the attention she needs. Aggi is eager to learn and thrive with the right care and patience.

NAME: Micha
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Micha! 💖 Micha is a sweet and sensitive female greyhound looking for a calm, loving home to help her blossom. With the right support and encouragement, she’s eager to learn and grow into a confident companion. She’ll thrive in a quiet environment where she feels safe and secure. Micha would do best as the only dog to start with, giving her the space and attention she needs to adjust and build trust. If you have a gentle heart and a peaceful home, Micha is ready to find comfort by your side. 🐶💕

NAME: Tubby
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Tubby! 💗 Tubby is a sweet girl who just needs a little time and patience to truly shine. 🌸 She can be a bit unsure at times, but with the right support and encouragement, she’ll blossom into a loving, confident companion. She’d do best in a calm, single-dog household where she can feel safe and truly be herself. With your love and guidance, Tubby is sure to thrive. 🐶💕

NAME: Sassy
TEXT: Sassy is a female greyhound looking for a quiet, supportive, and loving home. She needs room to grow, learn, and thrive, along with the encouragement and patience to help her blossom. A single-dog household would be ideal, where she can receive all the attention and care she deserves.

NAME: Molly
TEXT: Molly is a sweet female greyhound who can be a little shy and unsure at first, but she’ll open up with time and patience. She needs space, encouragement, and room to grow in a supportive environment. Molly thrives in a single-dog household where she can receive the love and attention she needs to feel comfortable and secure.

NAME: Minni
TEXT: Minni is a laid-back, easy-going older gal with a calm and confident demeanor. She’s curious and independent, but also affectionate and loves a good snuggle. Minni is the perfect companion for someone looking for a relaxed and loving pet.

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Lucy is a very friendly and affectionate older girl who loves to give and receive cuddles. She can be relaxed and easy-going, but also has a cheeky, playful side that adds fun to her personality. Good with smaller breeds of dogs, Lucy makes a sweet and loving companion for any home.

NAME: Banj
TEXT: Banj is a sweet, older female greyhound, ready to enjoy a relaxing retirement. She’s calm, easy-going, and laid-back, thriving in a peaceful home. Banj gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs and is comfortable around older children, making her the perfect companion for a quiet, loving household.

NAME: Snoz
TEXT: Snoz is a male greyhound with a calm and quiet demeanor. He’s patient, easy-going, and always happy, enjoying a laid-back lifestyle. With his gentle nature, he’s the perfect companion for anyone seeking a relaxed and peaceful pet.

NAME: Bella
TEXT: Meet Bella, a sweet, kind, and patient female greyhound who remains calm in new environments. She’s excited to play and learn, always eager for new experiences. Bella is affectionate and loves to spend time with her humans, and she gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs. She’s ready to bring her gentle spirit and enthusiasm for life to a loving home!

NAME: Nova
TEXT: Meet Nova, a beautiful and sweet female greyhound who will melt your heart once she settles into her new home. She’s affectionate and loves cuddles, and she has a playful side when it comes to toys! Nova is patient and eager to learn, making her a wonderful companion for a family who can help her continue to grow. She’s ready to share her love and brighten your life!

NAME: Bec
TEXT: Meet Bec, a playful and affectionate female greyhound who absolutely loves toys! She enjoys collecting and playing with them, and there's nothing better than a cuddle and some quality time with her humans. Bec thrives in a home with an experienced owner who can provide her with the care and attention she needs, including a backyard to run and explore. She’s grown up around children, but older kids are best for her. She’s ready to bring love and joy into a forever home!

NAME: Zac
TEXT: Meet this gentle and shy male greyhound, looking for a loving, supportive family to help him continue to grow and thrive. With a quiet nature, he enjoys the simple pleasures of life, like collecting little toys, and he responds beautifully to a gentle touch. Having grown up around small children, he’s well-suited for a family environment. An experienced dog owner would be ideal, as he’s looking for someone who can provide the patience and care he needs to flourish.

NAME: Tony
TEXT: Tony is a barrel full of laughs, love & fun! This big goof ball loves to run, play & chase. He is an active boy with a spirit to match! He would love to find a home with older active children he can run around with in the backyard. Potentially another grey or large breed of dog to play with as well. He is a confident boy who doesn't shy away from much. Tony is ready to find his perfect family! Reach out to meet him today!

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Beautiful Lucy is lady who needs to find a supportive, patient & kind family. Lucy shows interest in wanting to be a part of a family, grow, learn how to be confident & playful, she just needs that support & encouragement to do so. A quiet home at first would be ideal. Lucy has spent time indoors, around children & a smaller breed of dog. With the correct introduction & supervision, Lucy may become best friends with your smaller fluff's, even your feline family members. Please reach out if you would like to meet Lucy :)

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Sweet Missy is a darling girl looking for her perfect family. Missy is looking for love & support from her new family in order for her shine and grow into the best version of herself. A quiet & patient home would be best. With growth, she will shine in personality & playfulness. Missy responds well to young children. She has spent time living indoors with a smaller breed of dog. With the correct introduction, Missy might become best friends with your small pups or feline family members. Please reach out if you would like to meet her :)

NAME: Wichita
TEXT: Wichita is gorgeous, sweet girl, pretty chill but does get excited when running around with her other greymates! She absolutely loves water, a clam shell pool, which would keep her occupied as well as toys and is much quieter with the company of an older small dog as a companion but would also be happy as an only dog. She is fantastic with her household pet whippet, a small blue girl, and they love doing zoomies together but settle down quickly. She has such a loving nature, adores attention and pats, is well handled and good on lead. Wichi would make a lovely companion and walking buddy for couples, families with older kids and retirees, also happy to keep herself occupied for workers or with a whippet or similar as a playmate. * Wichita has a gorgeous whorl of hair that looks like a mane down the back of her neck - truly a unique girl.

NAME: Alf (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *Alf is in a foster home and is available for adoption!* See foster care update within. 'Alf is a true gentleman, who loves all people big or small, male or female. He exudes joy and happiness when you come home, or when visitors arrive. He is goofy when playing on the lawn with you, or chasing a thrown toy, then, just has to have a good lie down. His manners inside the house are impeccable, and doesn’t steal from the counter top or rubbish bin, doesn't destroy his toys or scratch doors. He knows not to be on couches or beds but given licence to do so he would love to accept. He manages 15+ stairs well and will travel in a lift. Car travel is for more sleeping. Thunder and lightning cause a little concern, but he only needs to be close – no hiding, just a little panting for this big boy. And what a handsome boy he is, accepting praise for his good looks wherever he goes. Alf is a beautiful, affectionate, gentle soul.' Alf is available from our Londonderry adoption centre.

NAME: Venus
TEXT: Venus may be 9 years old, but don’t let her age fool you – she certainly doesn’t act like it! This sweet, friendly girl is full of energy and loves being around people. She has the heart of a young pup and enjoys every moment spent with her humans. Venus is the perfect mix of a calm, affectionate companion and a fun-loving friend. Why You'll Love Venus: Friendly & People-Loving: Venus absolutely adores people and will be your best friend in no time. Young At Heart: Despite being 9 years old, Venus has the playful energy and spirit of a much younger dog! Calm & Affectionate: She loves cuddles and enjoys relaxing with you, but also has plenty of energy for playtime. If you’re looking for a loving, friendly greyhound who doesn’t act her age, Venus is the one for you! 💕

NAME: Jett
TEXT: Jett is a fun-loving and friendly female greyhound with a playful spirit and an easy-going personality. Born on April 3, 2022, she’s still young and full of energy but knows how to relax and enjoy quiet moments too. Jett’s happy, affectionate nature makes her a great companion for active families or anyone who enjoys a friendly, outgoing dog. Why You'll Love Jett: Playful & Friendly: Jett loves to have fun and is always ready to make new friends, whether it’s with humans or other dogs. Easy-Going: While playful, Jett is also calm and relaxed when it's time to chill. Good with Small Dogs: After a proper introduction, Jett gets along well with small dogs, making her a great addition to a multi-dog home. Young & Energetic: At just 2 years old, Jett has plenty of energy to enjoy walks, playtime, and adventures. Whilst being energetic Jett can be extremely lazy and would be happy to just laze around after a short walk. If you’re looking for a sweet, friendly greyhound with a playful personality, Jett might be your perfect match! 💕

NAME: Red
TEXT: This is our boy Red. He is relaxed on lead, great to handle. Red has had frequent exposure to leisurely strolls in town and enjoys the slow paced lifestyle. At times Red can be apprehensive with new people but warms up quickly after he has a good play. Red will be attending the ACT Adoption Day on March 22nd.

NAME: Dutch
TEXT: Dutch is a sweet sensitive hound, he may be a bit shy and quirky at first but he does warm up and is very gentle and affectionate. He is a handsome boy who is calm and laid back. Relaxes well on his own.

NAME: Kenny
TEXT: Meet Kenny! Kenny is the happiest dog you will ever meet! Kenny is a friendly, joyful pup who loves everyone he meets. He’s great with all dogs, making him the perfect companion for a multi-dog household. Whether it’s playing or just hanging out, Kenny gets along with dogs of all sizes. Kenny could also live with the right cat! He’s got a gentle and adaptable personality, so he may fit well into a home with a cat that’s comfortable around dogs. If you’re looking for a loving, happy dog to brighten your life, Kenny is your guy!

NAME: Summer
TEXT: *I am in a foster care home in Newtown in the inner west - reach out to the team to find out how I'm going!* The sun is shining - Summer is finally here! Well, Summer the greyhound that is! Summer is affectionate yet independent. She doesn’t mind spending time alone, making her a great fit for a variety of lifestyles. She has also spent time around children aged 3+ making her a great fit for families. Summer is a super social and friendly girl, making her perfect for those wanting an affectionate companion. She absolutely loves people, enjoys playtime, and settles beautifully inside. Summer is learning about the world and other dogs here at the centre and is doing so well! She would benefit from ongoing training for her dog sociability but is doing well at the centre. With the right family, Summer will thrive and make a wonderful companion. So grab your hat and sunnies and get ready to enjoy this ray of sunshine, available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Lilly
TEXT: Meet Lilly – A Sweet and Shy Greyhound! Lilly is a gentle and quiet female greyhound who may be a little shy at first, but once she gets to know you, her affectionate nature shines through. She’s great with all other dogs and would be sutiable for a home with a cat if you are patient and give her time to settle, making her an easy-going companion for any household. Lilly’s calm demeanor and low-key attitude make her the perfect choice for anyone looking for a laid-back, loving pet. Give her time to settle in, and she’ll reward you with endless loyalty and love!

NAME: Stacey
TEXT: Meet our sweet girl Stacey. Stacey warms up after a little bit of attention but initially she could be weary of her surroundings. She has spent time around children and is gentle around them. Stacey is responsive on lead but will like to sniff around as well.

NAME: Tracey
TEXT: Are you looking for the perfect all-arounder? Tracey will make for the perfect companion. Tracey has had frequent exposure to children and enjoys playing with them, she has also met chickens and cows at her current home. Tracey is incredibly engaging and responsive on lead; she has a great personality willing to people please.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is a good all round pet that is looking to bring joy to someone's home Jimmy has grown up in a farm style setting and is experienced around kids as young as 5 years of age. Jimmy is an active boy who walks very well on lead and would thrive with a daily walk before retiring to his bed for the night. Jimmy loves a cuddle and with extra training and love would be a great apartment dog. Unfortunately Jimmy is a single pet dog as he thrives by himself and isnt a big fan of sharing his family with other dogs off lead. Jimmy is still a gentle and loving boy who is looking for his perfect family

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Are you after a playful and cheeky friend? Benji is after his forever home! He is all things cheeky, confident and cunning. Benji is responsive on lead but some extra training wouldn't go astray. He loves a pat and to bound around a yard big or small, he would be suitable to live in a townhouse or villa and would in time be able to conquer stairs. Benji had an injury in 2023 which he has now recovered from but has a plate in his hock. If you're interested in learning more about Benji, please apply now.

NAME: Coco
TEXT: Coco is an old dog at heart despite being 3 years old Coco is a very good dog who is working on his recall training and is succeeding as he is a great learner. Coco would be the ideal pet for a backyard whether that be adopters who are retirees with no other pets or a young couple looking for a boy who doesn't mind going for a bit of adventure. Ideally Coco would suit fulltime working hours and also a backyard and has grown up around teenagers

NAME: Prince
TEXT: Prince is a friendly and well-mannered greyhound looking for his forever home. He’s fantastic around kids and settles well after initial excitement. He walks beautifully on a lead and has experience being around other dogs, including a small sausage dog for a short amount of time and a Labrador. Prince is an intelligent boy who will let you know when he needs something—whether it’s food or a toilet break—with a few attention barks. With a loving family and a little routine, he’ll make a wonderful companion. If you’re looking for a loyal and affectionate addition to your home, Prince might just be the perfect fit!

NAME: Gazza
TEXT: Confident, social and happy, are all great ways to describe Gazza. Gazza is social with other M-L breeds of dogs. Maaaate, he'd love to join Shazza, Bazza and Dazza on daily adventures! Gazza doesn't mind if those ankle-biters are in the home, either, more good old fun for him! Gazza would love to do his daily burn outs in the yard but will nap away on the porch once his few moments of fun are over. He's a sweet guy at heart who can't wait to find his crew! Grab a stubby and a meet Gazza at the local watering hole because this fair dinkum fella has a few yarns to tell! He can be adopted from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: King
TEXT: Meet King – A Playful and Friendly Greyhound! King is a 4 1/2-year-old male greyhound who is the perfect mix of fun and friendly! He’s an energetic and playful companion who loves to make new friends and enjoy exciting activities. Whether it’s running around, playing games, or splashing in the water, King is always up for some fun! This gentle and loving greyhound has a heart full of joy and a playful spirit that will keep you smiling. He’s not just fast on his feet – he also has a soft spot for water! Whether it’s swimming or playing in a sprinkler, King loves getting wet and cooling off on warm days. If you’re looking for a dog who’s friendly, fun, and full of energy, King might just be your perfect match! Medica

NAME: Jax (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Jax! This handsome boy is ready to find his forever home - Greeting you with a happy wagging tail and affectionate energy, Jax is sure to win over your heart in no time! Jax has had the pleasure of spending time with whippets, kids, and has been in a loving house setting, so he's already on his way to being well-versed in being a great family companion. Jax is looking for a forever family where he can offer endless affection and share his happy, friendly demeanour. If you're looking for a sweet companion to join your family, Jax might be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Bo
TEXT: Bo is a laid-back, cruisy greyhound who knows how to enjoy the simple things in life. He's a quiet guy, who loves to relax and take things slow, but don’t let his calm nature fool you—he’s got a heart full of love to give! Great with small dogs, Bo is the perfect companion for furry friends of all sizes. He’s also cat-workable, meaning he could fit in well with a home that has feline family members too. If you’re looking for a chill and friendly greyhound who’s ready to take life one relaxed step at a time, Bo’s your guy!

NAME: Iris
TEXT: Meet Iris, your soon-to-be favorite furry friend! This sweet and easy-going pup is all set to bring joy and love into your life. With her playful spirit and gentle personality, Iris is the perfect addition to any warm and welcoming home. She absolutely thrives on companionship and loves soaking up all the attention she can get! Iris is wonderfully adaptable, fitting seamlessly into both bustling households and peaceful settings. Whether your home is filled with laughter and activity or a cozy, quiet retreat, she’ll feel right at home. If you’re searching for a loyal friend who will shower you with affection and sprinkle a little extra happiness into your days, look no further—Iris is the one for you! Get ready for an amazing adventure with this lovely girl, who is sure to become a beloved member of your family.

NAME: Mo
TEXT: Gentle natured and affectionate, this senior boy will surely charm you with his adorable salt and pepper face. Mo has a lot of love to give and will share his affection with you from the moment you meet him. He has been around kids aged 1+ and would suit a home with kids who can respect his grandpa naps. Mo has shown wonderful manners with dogs big and small and is even learning about those so called "cats", too! We are hoping his forever home is full of soft beds, sunshine naps and treats...Maybe that could be you! Mo is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Angus
TEXT: Meet Angus, the sweet and happy greyhound who’s ready to find his forever home! He’s a gentle boy who requires his boundaries are respected. He also has some in-home experience. Angus would suit a home with a backyard/townhouse with a place to snooze without being bothered, and is happy to spend the day independently while you're gone, a long as he gets a few walks and some playtime. Angus is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Soy
TEXT: Meet Soy, the joyful canine companion who embodies the essence of youthful exuberance. Soy is young at heart and greets each day with an infectious sense of playfulness that will make your heart swell with joy. Soy's happy-go-lucky personality is perfect for anyone looking to bring energy and fun into their home. His playful spirit will have you rediscovering the joy in life's simplest pleasures, from playing in the backyard to leisurely walks around the neighborhood. Whether he's catching a ball or simply lounging by your side, Soy revels in the company of his human friends, showcasing his loyalty and affection in delightful ways.

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Bob is a cheerful and easy-going canine with a heart full of fun. His positive attitude is contagious, and he never fails to bring a smile to the faces of everyone he meets. Bob is the perfect blend of laid-back and playful, making him a versatile companion for various lifestyles. Whether you're seeking a buddy for leisurely walks in the park or a great companion for some backyard fun, Bob is your guy. When it comes to spreading happiness, Bob is a natural. His enthusiasm for life shines through in all he does, from simple lounging around with his favorite humans to exciting games of fetch or tug-of-war. If you're ready for endless moments of laughter and a devoted friend who delights in life's simple pleasures, Bob might just be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Alfie
TEXT: Meet Alfie, the lovable canine with a heart as big as his playful nature. Alfie is known for his boundless friendliness, making him an excellent companion for anyone seeking a playful, affectionate dog. Alfie enjoys nothing more than a good play session with medium to large breed friends. His playful energy is a perfect match for an active lifestyle, where he can gallop, jump, and frolic with fellow dog buddies, spreading joy and making friends easily. Consider Alfie if you're looking for an engaging and social pet to add to your family. With the right blend of companionship and play, Alfie will undoubtedly bring endless smiles and tail wags to your life.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Meet Jimmy, a laid-back and easygoing dog with a heart full of love to give. Jimmy is the perfect companion for those who appreciate a relaxed and unflustered canine friend. Jimmy is dog who adores the simple pleasures in life, from leisurely strolls in the park to quiet evenings lounging at home. He's not one to rush through life but rather takes his time to soak in his surroundings, making every moment feel special and serene. His chilled-out nature also makes him an excellent companion for other medium to large breed dogs. If you're in search of a dog who can seamlessly integrate into a tranquil lifestyle, whether you're single, a couple, or a family, Jimmy is ready to settle in and share his companionship with you. Get ready for leisurely adventures and cozy evenings with this loving and relaxed furry friend.

NAME: Paddy
TEXT: Mr Paddy! This gentle giant is such an easy-going, laid-back goof ball! He is always down to clown or just take it easy and rest his feet. He gets on well with smaller breeds of dogs- there's a Yorkie always saying hello :) Paddy interacts positively with new people, even younger children. He would love to have yard where he can run about, chasing toys thrown by his new best friends :)

NAME: Skip
TEXT: Meet Skip, the happy and friendly boy. This loyal and loving dog is always ready to greet you warmly and share a moment, no matter how small. Not only does Skip adore people, but he's also a social butterfly with other dogs, making him an incredible addition to multi-dog households. This charming canine companion will enrich your life with his unwavering loyalty and snuggles. Whether it’s a hike through the woods or a cozy night at home, Skip is just happy to be by your side, providing companionship, laughter, and unconditional love. If you're looking for a furry friend who always wears a smile and offers boundless affection, Skip might just be the perfect companion for your household.

NAME: Scout
TEXT: Meet Scout, a gentle soul of a dog. Scout is an easy-going companion, ready to fill your days with quiet affection and steadfast loyalty. His presence is soothing and his love is unconditional, offering the perfect balance in a fast-paced world. Scout's relaxed nature makes him the ideal partner for leisurely walks around the neighborhood or peaceful afternoons spent lounging in the backyard. He's more than content to curl up at your feet, providing the kind of quiet companionship that warms the heart. Scout would like a quiet home where is gets lots of love and affection. Scout has met cats and would settle with proper introduction and a calm easy going cat.

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Meet Bear, the ultimate embodiment of relaxation and tranquility wrapped up in a big, huggable package. This calm and easygoing canine companion resembles a giant teddy bear. Bear's favourite pastime is napping. Whether it's a lazy afternoon snooze on the patio or stretching out for a long, cozy rest beside you on the couch, Bear knows how to unwind like no other. While he might not be the most active pup on the block, Bear’s delightful charm lies in his serene nature. He's the perfect partner for a quiet afternoon reading session or watching a movie at home. Bear also enjoys a short walk around the block where he can have a sniff and explore Bear would thrive in a home where he can enjoy a relaxed lifestyle. While he may be big in size, his heart and loveable nature are even bigger.

NAME: King
TEXT: Introducing King, a regal canine companion who effortlessly lives up to his name with friendliness and charm. This amiable boy is known for his warm demeanor and ability to get along with both humans and his fellow canine friends. King has been crate trained and upholds pristine manners indoors, demonstrating his adaptiveness and intelligence. His crate is a cozy and secure retreat where he feels right at home. King appreciates having a structured, comfortable space that provides him with a sense of stability. King's sociable personality extends to all dogs, and he thrives on the companionship and joy of his furry peers. If you’re seeking a friendly, sociable, and well-mannered dog to be a part of your family or home, King is ready for royal treatment and a happy, loving environment King in the boy for you

NAME: Brinnie
TEXT: Meet Brinnie, a friendly boy wrapped up in a furry package! This delightful dog is on the hunt for a loving home, and he's ready to bring joy and companionship to your life. Brinnie is the definition of easygoing. He gets along splendidly with other dogs, making him a wonderful addition if you already have a canine companion or you're considering expanding your furry family. Brinnie's laid-back personality means he adapts well to various environments. He's content to enjoy some downtime with you or find a sunny spot for a relaxing nap. Equally, he'll never turn down a walk around the neighbourhood or a play date with furry friends. Whether you're a family looking for a reliable companion or an individual searching for a fuss-free friend, Brinnie's undeniable charm and friendly nature make him the ideal choice.

NAME: Dora
TEXT: Pleased to introduce you to the wonderful Dora! Dora is a senior lady looking to share her love with a new family. Dora has spent time living with a young family for approx 12 months & is now ready to find her forever home. She loves young children. Very patient & calm with them. Dora is gentle, kind & affectionate. Engaging in sweet cuddles & kisses. Dora may adapt to living on her own or in an apartment. Confident & content, she might well adapt to full-time workers as well :)

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Looking for a sweetheart that loves children, engaging in fun play & snuggling? Then Millie is the girl for you! Millie is very excitable & playful! Loves to run around being a little silly & cheeky. Quick to jump in a body of water.... even on picture day hehe :)

NAME: Vixen
TEXT: Meet Vixen, a spunky and joyful girl who’s ready to find her forever home! With her excitable energy and sweet cuddly nature, Vixen is the type of dog who’ll brighten anyone's day! While she’s got a ton of enthusiasm and excitement to share with her people, she’d be happiest as your one and only pup — so she can enjoy having all the attention to herself! Given the time and patience to adjust to her new routine, Vixen will quickly learn how to be the best companion and show you what an amazing pet she can be! If you’re looking for a loving & gentle girl with lots of personality and a zest for life, Vixen just might be your perfect match.

NAME: Banks
TEXT: Banks is in a foster home in a unit/apartment - read below to find out what he's been up to! "He's a very affectionate boy, loves pets, and presses his head into my chest or leg for neck scratches. He's pretty goofy and playful, loves a squeaky toy and has started bringing them to me to play. He's inquisitive, always wants to know what I'm doing or to investigate the not-too-scary sounds. He's been quite resilient all things considered! Even though he gets a bit anxious on walks sometimes, he still gets excited to go out the next time I pick up his leash, and will happily take himself up the stairs even knowing the loud cars are at the top - he's been very brave! I've been to leave him alone for 3-4 hours without issue - the one time I couldn't see him on my wifi cameras was because he'd decided to make himself comfortable in my bed while I was out! I doubt he'd have issues with a longer stint. Banks ended up meeting my landlord's small dog and spent some supervised time with her in my apartment. He was good, even initiating play at one point - it lasted all of a second though because she's about 1/10th his size, if that." Banks would suit a home with another dog, he is very dog social and loves spending time with other dogs. He would be OK with longer hours alone as tested in his foster home, and a house/unit with or without a backyard. He is still mastering the doggie door in foster care. Banks is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Friday
TEXT: *Friday is in a foster care unit apartment & is available to adopt - reach out to the team for more info!* Foster Care Update: Friday is such an incredibly loving and sweet boy. He loves neck and under chin scratches. He is very playful in the mornings but loves a good snooze on the couch and knows how to be calm in his bed during naps and the evening. He sleeps throughout the night with no inside accidents or barking/winning. He is a bit scared of unfamiliar noises such as trains, cars on the street and working on stairs with these noises. When outside he doesn't exhibit interest in small animals or birds. -------- Friday would suit a home with stair access. He enjoys being indoors, sunbaking with a mix of couch naps. Friday shows nice calm behaviours with a mix of playful and silly, making him a perfect addition to many home types. Respectful children would enjoy his gentle energy. He could live with another greyhound, too. Come and meet Friday at the Western Sydney adoption centre along with his dedicated foster carer!

NAME: Harley
TEXT: Meet Harley, a cheerful and easygoing companion. This friendly fella has a personality that's as warm as the summer sun, making him an ideal addition to any family seeking a loyal, loving dog. Harley has a delightful, laid-back nature about him. He is effortlessly sociable, having met small dogs with a friendly yet disinterested attitude, ready to just hang out and enjoy their company without demanding constant interaction. With his infectious happiness and calm, affectionate personality, Harley promises to be a wonderful companion for anyone seeking a peaceful, friendly presence in their life. If you’re ready to welcome an easygoing and friendly buddy into your life, Harley is more than ready to meet you.

NAME: Storm
TEXT: Relaxed & very loving older lady. Has spent time around grandchiildren. Storm is a confident girl looking for a life of leisure. She will do well on her own, with full time workers..... or if you might consider welcoming 2 beautiful ladies into your life, Storm’s sister, Chucky is also available :)

NAME: Chucky
TEXT: Sweet & adorable older gal. Independant & confident. Will adpat to full time workers. Has spent time around young grandchildren. Relaxed in new spaces & around new people. Sister to Storm! Would you consider welcoming both into your family?

NAME: Garnet
TEXT: **Garnet has lived in a foster home in the city CBD with full time workers, is affectionate and intelligent, and loves long walkies and would enjoy an active family to keep fit and go on daily adventures with** She's been a joy to foster! Here's a glimpse into Garnet's wonderful traits: - Garnet is an early bird who enjoys morning naps after joining you in bed. - A fearless adventurer, she's unbothered by much and walks in loud, busy city streets. - Walks in the rain without hesitation. - Patiently waits outside shops while you run quick errands. - Curious by nature, Garnet follows you around, eager to be part of your activities. - Loves to relax and roach on the couch. - Enjoys chasing Frisbees, balls, and playing with squeaky toys. - An exceptional office companion and assistant. - Incredibly friendly and affectionate, she welcomes pats from everyone she meets. - Gentle with children she meets. - Gets super excited about snacks, especially denta sticks! - Loves to taste a variety of foods, from peanut butter, hot chips, and banana. - Garnet has accompanied professional dog walkers, who have consistently praised how well she walks on the lead. Garnet has been a delight in the home, and I'm sure she'll make an excellent addition to a loving family. We’ll certainly miss her! If you're looking for a dog to fill your home with love and joy then apply to adopt the gorgeous Garnet today!

NAME: Rissole
TEXT: Rissole is a handsome blue boy. Described as a happy, cheerful bubbly boy, we think he could live with older kids and would be content with a courtyard or backyard to call his own. He can be shy when you first get to know him, so a home who enjoy bringing a dog out of their shell will be the best fit for this pretty boy. We have noticed he is more confident around other hounds, and would suit a home with another doggie pal, but not a requirement. He is looking for a quiet loving home - could it be you? Rissole is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Astro
TEXT: Yep, Astro is astronomically cute! This gorgeous boy is looking for a quiet backyard, with or without a dog, he's even friendly with small dogs! What a polite and lovely boy....read on to learn more! This sweet boy is currently learning our stairs, to gain his stair licence, one step at a time. He is best suited for shorter hours with or without a doggie pal while he learns to settle in. He's also learning to be friends with cats - watch this space! A backyard with indoor outdoor access and a quiet home who can nurture Astro into the best pet will be the best match for him. Astro is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Pattie
TEXT: Meet Pattie, a gentle and gracious senior who has spent her life expertly spreading love and warmth. Pattie has been in the company of children and copes well with if they are polite and well mannered. Pattie is a well-mannered lady who carries herself with a polite serenity, she has been socialised with small dogs and although she would prefer a large companion she is polite around small dogs. Pattie has slowed in her senior years, but she would love a foster home where she can settle and would be the perfect companion for someone looking for an older calm companion.

NAME: Arthur (Western Sydney)
TEXT: And I say HEY! What a wonderful kind of day. If you can learn to work and play and get along with Arthur the greyhound! Arthur is a total cutie pie. He is the star of the show, much like the 90's show! Arthur would enjoy a home without another canine companion, and would prefer his family members to be older children or adults only. He is super polite with other hounds but doesn't need their companionship, so being a solo pet is best for this independent boy. He is a shy boy at heart, but loves smooches and cuddles once you get to know him. A backyard or courtyard would be preferred while he learns the ins and outs of pet life. He can even do stairs, walking on a loose lead, as well as learning some training cues like 'on your bed' and 'off your bed'... Talk about talented! It's a simple message and it comes from the heart, Believe in this (and in Arthur the greyhound) for that's the place to start! Arthur is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Cookie (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Cookie is a friendly & social girl looking for her new home where she will be surrounded by love and attention! She’s very human-focused and loves being around people, always displaying positive consent and gentle affection. Whether it’s playtime or cuddle time, she’s sure to brighten your day! Cookie does very well walking calmly on a lead, making walks a relaxed and enjoyable experience. She’s also shown to be good around our other greyhounds, and could be happy sharing her new home with another medium/large doggie friend - Pending a Meet & Greet at our Western Sydney site. Contact us today to learn more about this lovely girl and discuss booking in an appointment to meet her!

NAME: Wynstan
TEXT: Wynstan with a Y here...let me tell you a bit about myself! I hope you like a happy affectionate boy, if so, read on! I love to lean on my handlers and show off my adorable affectionate nature. Did anyone tell you I'm also polite with big and small dogs? Seriously, I'm a catch! I'm also all about my treats, so if you're looking to teach me tricks, please involve snacks too! This will help me settle in and learn how to be the best pet for you. Everyone says I'm amazing, so I guess they love how I walk so nicely and gently on the lead for walkies, too! I'm available from the Western Sydney adoption centre, see you soon!

NAME: Paul
TEXT: Paul is a stunning boy who is great to play with, can be left alone. He is social and confident with other dogs and a good walker on the lead.

NAME: Ace
TEXT: Ace is currently in a foster home with his sister Katie. We have loved getting to know Ace and giving him the opportunity to enjoy his new life as a pet. Affectionally known to us as our ‘Sookie Lala’, Ace just wants to be by your side 24/7. He loves being close and seeing what things you are getting up to throughout your day. He also loves the outdoor (and indoor) couch and will happily settle in there for the day when outside. Ace will bounce happily on his toes when we come home and loves a hug and cuddle. We are teaching him how to play fetch and he really enjoys being included in any play time activities. He is toilet trained and sleeps very well throughout the night. Ace walks wonderfully on a leash as he likes to be right by your side. He doesn’t react negatively to other dogs, big or small and is very friendly to other small dogs and children. If you have love to give and are looking for a dog to soak it all in – Ace is your boy! ______________________________________________________________________________ Ace is a playful and gentle hound. He was very friendly and nice when he met my daughter and was good company with a good balance of being playful and affectionate. Gets along great with other greyhounds. Currently fostered in a suburban home and getting comfy coming inside the house and loving the backyard.

NAME: Katie
TEXT: Katie is currently in a foster home with her brother Ace. We have loved getting to know Katie and giving her the opportunity to enjoy her new life as a pet. Being the older sister, she is very independent and settles very easily. She is very happy to sit on her bed whilst you work or go about your day. She is toilet trained and has fallen into her new routine very easily. She gets so excited to see us, as exemplified with her happy, whipping tail (duck for cover!). She tends to jump up on you when she’s very excited, but this is something we are working on and have already seen great improvements on. Katie walks well on a leash and doesn’t react negatively to other dogs, big or small. She has done well approaching small dogs and children and saying hello. Katie would be a great pet for a someone looking for an independent dog that will also shower you will love and affection. __________________________________________________________________________ Katie is a lovely hound. She is happy and confident, very playful. Does appreciate a good lay down also. Has been living in a rural setting is no stranger to native animals and is now in suburban foster care enjoying cuddly toys, living out the back and coming in the home for the evening.

NAME: Flash
TEXT: **I'm in a foster home** Flash is seeking an empathetic & nurturing owner who can follow a cooperative care plan to help with his daily eye medication. Could you be the perfect owner for our sweet boy? Flash has advanced pannus, which means he needs daily eye medication. But don’t worry—he’s a star pupil when it comes to taking his meds & he’s getting better every day with the right guidance. Flash is currently learning all sorts of new tricks at the adoption centre. He is a fast learner and with a little time and practice, he's shown he can do amazing things. A large yard where Flash can stretch his legs and zoom around is a must! He loves a good run, and a big space is perfect for his energy. No small children or other animals.
